summary: Flashes of your life become clearer and more frequent, allowing you to apply skills you developed while alive.

name: Phantom Resemblance
summary: Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember.

name: Plague Sniffer
summary: You can sniff out the pungent tang of disease.

name: Planar Resilience
summary: Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels.

name: Ponpoko
summary: No true tanuki would ever be caught without a musical instrument to play under the full moon.

name: Pounding Leap
summary: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air.

name: Powerful Guts
summary: Your stomach is particularly durable.

name: Practiced Paddler
summary: You’re skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony.

name: Precious Alloys
summary: Your unarmed attacks gain the properties of special materials.

name: Pride Hunter
summary: You avoid the attention of creatures focused on your allies.

name: Prodigious Climber
summary: Your natural climbing ability and technique has made you a potent climber.

name: Project Persona
summary: Where others etch their armor to serve as a conduit for their imaginations, your vivid mind and bold personality allow you to project a more fitting persona over your lackluster armor.

name: Protective Claws
summary: The chitin on your claws is so hard you can defend against attacks with them.

name: Protective Sheath
summary: When you lash out with your clan dagger, you keep its sheath close at hand.

name: Protective Subroutine
summary: Your nanites can augment your defenses.

name: Proud Mentor
summary: You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments.

name: Puzzle Solver
summary: You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown.

name: Quick Root
summary: You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing.

name: Quick Stow
summary: You Interact to store one item you're holding in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).

name: Rabid Sprint
summary: You run on all fours as fast as you can.

name: Ragdya's Revelry
summary: You dart away from your foe's attack with a casual laugh, using the opening to cause mischief.

name: Rat Magic
summary: There always seems to be a little rat around to carry messages for you.

name: Ratfolk Roll
summary: You roll up into a ball and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline.

name: Read the Roots
summary: The root systems of trees are a far-reaching network of information, and you know how to access them and extract their secrets.

name: Recognize Ambush
summary: Your combat training has honed you to be ready for an attack at all times.

name: Reflective Pocket
summary: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space.

name: Reincarnated Ridiculer
summary: You’ve practiced the art of taunting an enemy, ensuring they know death will only make you stronger.

name: Rekindled Light
summary: You temporarily drain your star orb familiar’s energy to save an ally.

name: Renewing Quills
summary: Your spines grow back much faster than other shisks.

name: Replicate
summary: You've learned to reshape your malleable form.

name: Resilient Physiology
summary: Your ordered physiology rejects unwelcome elements, allowing you to reject the negative effects of poisons and diseases or shrug off other lasting negative effects.

name: Restoring Blood
summary: Your body can process an alternative to your venom that heals wounds.

name: Reveal Hidden Self
summary: While hidden, you manifest a version of your animalistic nature.

name: Right-hand Blood
summary: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous.

name: Riptide Mount
summary: After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them.

name: Ritual Reversion
summary: You can temporarily revert to a less conspicuous form without diminishing your senses.

name: Runtsage
summary: Unlike most of your kind, who dismiss goblins as embarrassments or expendable annoyances, you have studied the methodology behind their irresponsible and incomprehensible actions.

name: Scar-Thick Skin
summary: Glorious, storied scars cover and protect much of your body, girding you in fleshly armor that resists any wound weaker than those you have already survived.

name: Scion of Many Planes
summary: The long and complicated history of your bloodline manifests in your ability to draw power from more planar sources than most other nephilim.

name: Scurry!
summary: Your instincts to move to safety are strong.

name: Sealed Poppet
summary: You've reinforced your interior parts with sealant or other flame-retardant materials, protecting you from fire.

name: Secondary Adaptation
summary: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult.

name: Sense Allies
summary: Like many humans raised in a close-knit community, you have always been strongly attuned to the presence of others.

name: Shadowplay
summary: As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy.

name: Shadowy Disguise
summary: You wrap yourself in shadow to change your appearance.

name: Shame the Sin
summary: Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them.

name: Shared Luck (Halfling)
summary: You are evidence that it’s lucky to travel with a halfling.

name: Shed Tail
summary: You can shed a portion of your tail to escape.

name: Sheltering Slab
summary: The stone around you is your ally, and you have learned to use it to shore up your weaknesses.

name: Shifting Faces
summary: You wear many faces, even those that don't belong to you.

name: Shoki's Argument
summary: You feel a connection to shokis, the rambling collectors of wayward souls, and might have found old texts written by one.

name: Signature Weapon
summary: Your energy saturates one of your weapons; it might be one inherited or one tied to your history.

name: Skilled Climber
summary: You can navigate vertical surfaces with ease.

name: Skilled Swimmer
summary: You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice.

name: Skillful Climber
summary: You can scamper up or down surfaces as nimbly as a monkey.

name: Skillful Tail
summary: You’ve always had a tail, but with practice, you’ve learned to use it for more than signaling your mood.

name: Skin Split
summary: You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin.

name: Sleep of the Reborn
summary: Philosophers compare the cycle of life, death, and rebirth to sleeping, dreaming, and waking.

name: Slip with the Breeze
summary: You create gusts of wind when you jump, allowing you to carry yourself across greater distances.

name: Smoke Through Bamboo
summary: You’ve spent significant time slipping silently between bamboo thickets, and your light-footedness allows you to navigate even the thickest forests and brush with ease.

name: Snare Genius
summary: If the snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead.

name: Soaring Flight
summary: You Fly.

name: Spark Fist
summary: You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent.

name: Spark of Independence
summary: You touch a creature with the minion trait and share the heightened sense of autonomy you've discovered.

name: Speak with Flowers
summary: At your very heartwood, you're a flower animated by elder magic, and with a little effort, you can speak to your kindred.

name: Speak with Kindred
summary: You have a connection with creatures that share your physiology.

name: Speak with the Sleeping
summary: You can speak to all inanimate objects and the slumbering spirits within them.

name: Speaker in Training
prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or the ability to cast a divine or primal spell
summary: You've begun your training as a Speaker.

name: Spell Survivor
summary: Once you’ve resisted an opponent’s magic, anything else they throw your way becomes less effective.

name: Spirit Soother
summary: You are attuned to the minute sounds and sensations of restless spirits.

name: Springing Leaper
summary: Your powerful legs allow you to make sudden and dramatic leaps.

name: Statue Form
summary: An inconspicuous statue in front of a shop is the perfect form to wait for things to blow over.

name: Steam Spell
summary: You transform your fire spells into steam, making them more effective underwater.

name: Stem the Tide
summary: You can cast _protector tree_ as a 1st-rank primal innate spell once per day.

name: Step Lively
summary: You are an expert at avoiding the lumbering footsteps of larger creatures.

name: Storming Gaze
summary: You can open or energize a notable third eye on your forehead to strike with storming power.

name: Stretching Reach
summary: You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes.

name: Strix Vengeance
summary: You dedicate yourself to destroying those who harm your kin.

name: Strong of Wing
summary: You can fly with a greater distance.

name: Strong Tail
summary: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land.

name: Supernatural Charm
summary: The elven magic in your blood manifests as a force you can use to become more appealing or alluring.

name: Swamp Stealth
summary: In swamplands, you are particularly skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage, or moving quietly through murky water.

name: Swift Swimmer
summary: You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

name: Swimming Poppet
summary: Your fins, flippers, or other accessories assist with steering you through water.

name: Tail Snatch
summary: You can whip your tail around to lash items from the unwary's grip.

name: Tail Spin
summary: You excel at using your tail as a weapon to upend your foes.

name: Taste Blood
prerequisite: Cel Rau, Straveika, Svetocher, or another lineage from a vampire with the Drink Blood ability
summary: You retain not only your vampiric parent's taste for blood but their ability to gain vitality from it.

name: Tenacious Jaws
summary: Your teeth are curved or hooked to hold on to your enemies.

name: Tenacious Net
summary: Escaping your nets is no simple task.

name: Tengu Feather Fan
summary: You've learned to bind some of your feathers together into a fan to focus your ancestral magic.

name: The Moon Weaver's Art
summary: You’ve learned to create minor illusions by collecting strands of moonlight and weaving them together to create small images or cloaking veils.

name: Thousand-Year Grudge
summary: You can call upon your former lives and project all of your accumulated frustration, failure, and despair through your eyes at a target, overwhelming their senses.

name: Thrown Voice
summary: You've learned how to throw your voice through the winds, tricking others as to your location.

name: Tikling Bird Twirl
summary: You trained your footwork by dancing to music between snapping bamboo poles, and your increased mobility helps you succeed when hunting dangerous beasts or fighting multiple opponents.

name: Tip the Scales
summary: You’re a cunning adversary in close quarters and are well-versed in hit-and-run tactics that exploit the advantages of your small stature.

name: Tomb-Watcher's Glare
summary: When you critically hit an undead creature, or an undead creature critically fails a saving throw against one of your abilities, you drive your divine wrath home in your enemy’s heart.

name: Tongue Disarm
summary: You lash out with your tongue to disarm your foe.

name: Torch Goblin
summary: You’ve spent enough time on fire that you know how to use it to your advantage.

name: Tough Tumbler
summary: You’ve taken your share of licks while scurrying around the battlefield and know how to defend yourself against opportunistic attackers.

name: Towering Presence
summary: You tap into your planar heritage and momentarily grow larger through force of will.

name: Traditional Resistances
prerequisite: Arcane Dragonblood, Divine Dragonblood, Occult Dragonblood, or Primal Dragonblood
summary: Due to your blood, you have some resistance to certain types of magic.

name: Tranquil Sanctuary
summary: Whenever possible, you follow the serene path and encourage others to do the same.

name: Transposable Compliance
summary: Your protean vitality is fecund and many-succoring: your veins run with life-giving ichor that adapts to the blood and physiology of any body, and your skin molts on command, creating wound-stanching sheaths of tissue for yourself and others.

name: Treacherous Earth
summary: You have the power to shatter the earth into a shape of your devising.

name: Tree Climber (Goblin)
prerequisite: Tailed Goblin heritage or Treedweller Goblin heritage
summary: Your time in forest or jungle canopies has taught you how to scramble across branches with sure feet.

name: Tree's Ward
summary: You've lived among trees for so long they recognize your presence and seek to protect you from harm.

name: Treespeech
summary: Your connection to elemental wood allows you to communicate with trees in the Universe in Muan, the language of wood elementals.

name: Tripkee Glide
summary: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall.

name: Tunnel Roll
summary: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball.

name: Unassuming Heroes
summary: You have a talent for making friends through simple kindness, often among stray animals or other creatures that people tend to overlook, and your inherent magic can make these acts take on additional power.

name: Uncanny Awareness
summary: You have a keen sense of movement around you.

name: Undead Companion
prerequisite: an animal companion or a familiar
summary: Your companion is also touched by undeath, a mix of a traditional companion and a skeleton, zombie, or stranger form of unlife.

name: Undead Slayer
summary: Your knowledge of your own not-quite-living anatomy, combined with your experience in combat, helps you take down undead foes with ease.

name: Unlock Secret
summary: You delve deeper into your psychic potential.

name: Urban Jungle
prerequisite: Fascinated by Society; Expert in Society or Expert in Survival
summary: Cities are just a new form of wilderness.

name: Vanara Weapon Trickery
summary: You've learned how to trick your foes using vanara weapons.

name: Vandal
summary: You have a knack for breaking and dismantling things.

name: Venom Gulp
summary: You can store prepared venom in your throat and spit it at your foes in addition to your own toxic spray.

name: Venom Spit
summary: You've learned the art of lobbing toxic spittle at vulnerable spots on your foes, especially the eyes.

name: Victorious Vigor
summary: Your victories in battle fill you with pride and imbue you with the energy to fight a bit longer despite your wounds.

name: Vishkanya Weapon Arts
summary: You are graceful and efficient in the use of vishkanyan weapons.

name: Voice of the Elements
summary: You inherit a primal dragon’s bond to base elements.

name: Vomit Stomach
summary: In dire circumstances you can vomit out your stomach to expel toxins.

name: Vulpine Scamper
summary: You’re especially nimble while in your full fox shape.

name: Ward Against Corruption
summary: Your soul is warded against the power of undeath and plague, as well as that of the evil former psychopomps known as sahkils.

name: Warding Jewel
summary: A life of hunting and battle has caused your head gem to attune to the waxing moon, which has manifested in the power to protect you from harm.

name: Warp Likeness
summary: You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own.

name: Water Conjuration
summary: You carry the ocean with you wherever you go.

name: Wavetouched Paragon
summary: You have been blessed by the sea, granting you the ability to swim like a fish.

name: Well of Potential
prerequisite:
focus pool, at least one innate spell from a
kashrishi heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at
least one of your focus spells
summary: Your mind is a deep well of psychic potential.

name: Well-armed
summary: Your detachable limbs offer flexibility.

name: Well-Groomed
summary: You are fastidious about keeping clean.

name: Wild Stride
summary: You can move quickly when using your preferred modes of travel.

name: Wildborn Adept
summary: The whispers of the jungle grant you more diverse access to simple primal magic.

name: Winglets
summary: Through the lingering influence of your warren's patron, you've sprouted a small set of wings.

name: Withstand the Storm
summary: Your skin hardens like bark and gains the sheen of glazed clay, lessening the wild’s ruinous sting against your body.

name: Zip! Zoom!
summary: You can fly longer distances before you need to land.

name: Abscission Shards
summary: You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target.

name: Adaptive Mask Familiar
summary: Your mask familiar adapts quickly to material form, allowing it to gain more familiar and master abilities.

name: Additional Recollection
summary: You scan the battlefield quickly, remembering critical details about multiple opponents you face.

name: Additional Servings
prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore
summary: Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

name: Advanced Arcana
summary: You gain one wizard feat.

name: Advanced Blood Potency
summary: You gain one sorcerer feat.

name: Advanced Bloodline
summary: You draw more power from your bloodline.

name: Advanced Bow Training
summary: Through constant practice and the crucible of experience, you increase your skill with advanced bows.

name: Advanced Breakthrough
summary: You gain one inventor feat.

name: Advanced Concoction
summary: You gain one alchemist feat.

name: Advanced Deduction
summary: You gain one investigator feat.

name: Advanced Defender
summary: You gain one guardian feat.

name: Advanced Devotion
summary: You gain one champion feat.

name: Advanced Dogma
summary: You gain one cleric feat.

name: Advanced Element Control
summary: You gain one kineticist feat.

name: Advanced Elemental Spell
prerequisite: flame order, stone order, storm order, or wave order
summary: Your connection to one of the great elemental aspects of nature deepens, allowing you further control over its powers.

name: Advanced Field Training
summary: You gain a commander feat.

name: Advanced Flair
summary: You gain one swashbuckler feat.

name: Advanced Fury
summary: You gain one barbarian feat.

name: Advanced Glory
summary: You gain an exemplar feat.

name: Advanced Herbalism
summary: Your herbalist talents continue to grow with use and you have become potent at making even more remedies from less.

name: Advanced Hunter's Trick
summary: You gain one ranger feat.

name: Advanced Kata
summary: You gain one monk feat.

name: Advanced Maneuver
summary: You gain a fighter feat.

name: Advanced Martial Magic
summary: You gain one magus feat.

name: Advanced Monastic Weaponry
summary: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease.

name: Advanced Muse's Whispers
summary: You gain one bard feat.

name: Advanced Mysteries
summary: You gain one oracle feat.

name: Advanced Poisoncraft
summary: You can create up to 6 poisons per day with advanced alchemy.

name: Advanced Qi Spells
summary: Your talent at controlling your qi has reached new heights.

name: Advanced Revelation
summary: Divine power reveals greater mysteries to you.

name: Advanced Shooter
summary: You've dedicated your training to the most complex and weird weapons of your favorite group.

name: Advanced Shooting
summary: You gain one gunslinger feat.

name: Advanced Synergy
summary: You gain one summoner feat.

name: Advanced Thaumaturgy
summary: You gain one thaumaturge feat.

name: Advanced Thoughtform
summary: You gain one psychic feat.

name: Advanced Trickery
summary: You gain one rogue feat.

name: Advanced Weapon Training
summary: You’ve studied the art of wielding an advanced weapon.

name: Advanced Wilding
summary: You gain one druid feat.

name: Advanced Witchcraft
summary: You gain one witch feat.

name: Advantageous Assault
summary: After compromising your enemy’s movement, you deliver a more deadly blow.

name: Agile Maneuvers
summary: Your easily maneuver against your foes.

name: Aldori Riposte
summary: You riposte with your Aldori dueling sword when your enemy leaves an opening.

name: Align Qi
summary: The power of your qi soothes your wounds and energizes you for battle.

name: Analyze Idiolect
prerequisite: Linguist Dedication; Expert in Deception; Expert in Society
summary: You break down a specific individual’s idiolect, memorizing their speech mannerisms and habits.

name: Analyze Weakness
summary: Your knowledge of a creature’s physiology helps you attack with pinpoint accuracy.

name: Animal Skin
summary: Your proficiency in unarmored defense increases to expert.

name: Animal Strength
summary: You tap into the primal strength of your _animal feature_.

name: Animate Net
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _animate rope_
summary: When you cast _animate rope_, you can modify it to animate a net.

name: Animist's Power
summary: You gain one animist feat.

name: Anticipate Ambush
summary: You keep watch for any hidden creatures or dangerous sites, moving at half your travel Speed.

name: Antler Rush
summary: Stride twice.

name: Apparition Stabilization
summary: Your attuned apparition ensures that even if you would be distracted or disrupted, your magic does not go to waste.

name: Arcana of Iron
summary: You eschew wands and staves for more advanced weaponry.

name: Arcane Sensitivity
summary: You can sense the presence of the supernatural, even if you don't have any magical ability yourself.

name: Archaeologist's Warning
summary: You visually or audibly warn your companions of danger, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

name: Armor Specialist
summary: You have trained hard to optimize your armor's unique protective qualities to maximize the materials used in its creation.

name: Artery Map
summary: While you’ve learned all the places a scalpel can cause extensive bleeding to avoid disasters in surgery, such knowledge can serve other purposes.

name: Artokus's Fire
summary: Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire.

name: Ash Strider
trait: Air, Composite, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Polymorph, Primal
summary: You discorporate into a cloud of whirling ash and Stride.

name: Assured Knowledge
summary: You can procure information with confidence.

name: Axe Thrower
summary: You have mastered the weight and balance of a variety of axes and can lob them with ease.

name: Basic Magus Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic bounded spellcasting benefits.

name: Basic Scroll Cache
summary: You have a vast and overflowing collection of scroll  scraps, riddled with errors and misspellings and leaking energy like a sieve.

name: Basic Summoner Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic bounded spellcasting benefits.

name: Battle-Tested Companion
summary: Your companion is a tried and tested ally of unshakable reliability.

name: Battlefield Agility
summary: Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself.

name: Bear Hug
summary: You snatch at your opponent with your claws, pulling them close in a ferocious bear hug.

name: Bear Hug
summary: You hug your opponent.

name: Beast Gunner Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana; Trained in Crafting; expert with at least one type of firearm, you own a beast gun and have slain the type of creature associated with your beast gun in a fair hunt (see above)
summary: You've bonded to your beast gun and unlocked the first hints of its hidden potential.

name: Beastmaster's Trance
summary: You can enter a trance that allows you to briefly inhabit the body of one of your animal companions and share its senses.

name: Bellflower Dedication
prerequisite: Charisma 14; Expert in Stealth; Expert in Survival; member of the Bellflower Network
summary: You dedicate yourself to freeing slaves and escorting them to freedom.

name: Benevolent Spirit Deck
summary: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards that seek to protect you or an ally.

name: Bestial Protection
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion that’s Large or larger
summary: Your companion's mere presence is enough to rattle creatures that fall under its shadow.

name: Betraying Shank
summary: While your usual diplomacy is well intentioned, you know that sometimes those same skills will need to be turned to deception.

name: Binding Serpents Celestial Arrow
summary: As you prepare to shoot your weapon, you invoke divine serpents that bind your enemies.

name: Blazing Spirit
summary: Your apparition grants fiery defenses.

name: Blazing Talon Surge
summary: You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire.

name: Blessed Sentinel
summary: You infuse a weapon with the blessing of Ketephys and attack.

name: Blood Frenzy
summary: Your eidolon flies into a frenzy.

name: Boaster's Challenge
prerequisite: Expert in Deception, Expert in Diplomacy, or Expert in Intimidation; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
summary: You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat.

name: Bolera's Interrogation
summary: You can force a creature to tell the truth

name: Brains!
summary: You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor.

name: Brutal Bully
summary: You push your foes around and leave bruises.

name: Burning Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; fire is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental fire, causing it to set the target on fire.

name: Butterfly's Kiss
summary: You can make nonlethal Strikes with a butterfly sword without taking a penalty.

name: Butterfly's Sting
summary: You gain the sneak attack class feature.

name: Cadence Call
summary: You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm.

name: Cadre
prerequisite: Captain Dedication; expert in Diplomacy or Intimidation
summary: Between your daring adventures, people seek you out.

name: Cannon Corner Shot
summary: By loading special ammunition in a particular way, you can make your siege weapons do all manner of tricks that other siege engineers can barely even imagine.

name: Captivating Intensity
summary: Your ability to captivate others has grown, and you can use your captivator abilities more often.

name: Cascade Bearer's Flexibility
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation
summary: You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation.

name: Cascade Countermeasure
summary: When in Arcane Cascade, you can make yourself resistant to magic.

name: Cast Down
summary: The sheer force of your faith can bring a foe crashing down.

name: Cast Out
summary: You attempt to cast a malevolent entity out of the creature or object it's possessing.

name: Cauterize
summary: You use the smoking barrel of your firearm to sear shut a bleeding wound.

name: Ceremonial Knife
summary: You have prepared a special knife to direct energies when spellcasting.

name: Champion's Reaction
summary: You can gain and use the champion’s reaction associated with your cause

name: Claim the Field
summary: You hurl your banner forward with precision, claiming the battlefield for yourself and your allies.

name: Clean Take
summary: Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable.

name: Clear as Air
trait: Air, Illusion, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal
summary: Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day.

name: Clear the Way
summary: You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path.

name: Cleave
summary: You swing clear through one foe and into another.

name: Clinch Strike
summary: Your opponents can’t slip your grasp without punishment.

name: Cloaking Pulse
summary:
Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the Drape Ambient Magic action.

 **Drape Ambient Magic** <actions string="Single Action" /> (illusion) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** Your ostilli turns clear as it converts its stored magic into a bubble of refracting light around you.

name: Clockwork Celerity
summary: You can use unstable clockwork devices in your innovation to push your invention to act more quickly.

name: Combination Finisher
summary: You combine a series of attacks with a powerful finishing blow.

name: Combine Elixirs
summary: You can add the full ingredients of a second elixir to an elixir you make to create a hybrid concoction.

name: Commitment to Justice
summary: When your allies are harmed, you deliver retribution.

name: Commitment to Liberty
summary: You can’t abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip.

name: Confounding Image
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mirror image_
summary: When you cast _mirror image_, you can modify it to create a duplicate of yourself.

name: Connect the Dots
summary: Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade.

name: Construct Shell
summary: You've adjusted your construct innovation so that when you ride it, special plates, hollows, or similar form partial barriers around you to add additional protection.

name: Consume Power
summary: You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate.

name: Convincing Illusion
summary: You use your deceptive skills to make your illusions seem even more real.

name: Corrupted Shield
summary: Your shield ally is more than just a spirit of protection— it's a conduit for deadly divine magic.

name: Counter Element
summary: Your absolute dedication to a single element lets you attempt to gain control over it, even when the element is in service to another entity.

name: Counter Perform
summary: You gain the counter performance composition spell.

name: Cozy Campfire
summary: You spend 1 hour building a campfire in a single unoccupied square and whispering the stories of those you’ve met on your journeys.

name: Craft Facsimile
prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You're renowned for your ability to recover important items and sometimes that requires creating a stand-in.

name: Crane Flutter
summary: You interpose your arm between yourself and your opponent.

name: Crawling Fire
summary: You mimic the motions of a beast of your devising, and it becomes real, with a flaming pelt and searing claws.

name: Crimson Shroud
summary: You swathe yourself in a veil of red mist for 1 minute.

name: Crossbow Terror
summary: Your skill with a crossbow strikes terror into your opponents when you threaten them with the next bolt.

name: Crowd Mastery
summary: You use the crowd to your advantage, diverting your foes’ attention to potential hidden dangers in the crowd.

name: Crown of the Saumen Kar
summary: Your body begins to evolve and adapt, taking the first steps towards blending your very self with the ancient curse of the saumen kar.

name: Crushing Step
summary: The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments.

name: Culvert's Collapse
summary: Under your foes’ onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs.

name: Current Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; air or water is in your elemental philosophy
summary: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you divert some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

name: Current Spell
summary: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

name: Cutting Heaven, Crushing Earth
summary: Your skill in combining fist and blade has grown into a seamless art where each attack makes an opponent more vulnerable to the next.

name: Daring Act
prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
summary: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies.

name: Dash of Herbs
trait: Healing, Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Vitality, Wood
summary: A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature.

name: Dashing Pickup
prerequisite: Cavalier Dedication; expert in Acrobatics or Athletics
summary: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has the corresponding movement type).

name: Daywalker
summary: Through a profane pledge or a bloodline quirk, you can tolerate the sun's light.

name: Dazing Blow
summary: You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them.

name: Dazzling Bullet
summary: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes.

name: Death Roll
summary: You corkscrew your body, twisting your victim.

name: Death Warden
summary: With your intimate familiarity with the duality of positive and negative energy, you're able to stand as a bulwark against death and undeath alike.

name: Deathly Secrets
summary: No means of creating or ruling the undead is beyond your grasp, even those of magical traditions not your own.

name: Debilitating Bomb
summary: You can add a crystalline additive to an alchemical bomb to have it undermine your enemy.

name: Defend Mount
summary: You interpose yourself between an attacker and your mount, defending your mount from harm.

name: Defensive Coordination
summary: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line.

name: Defensive Growth
summary: You grow a shield of woven flowers and branches, then Raise that Shield to defend yourself from the triggering attack.

name: Deflecting Pulse
summary:
Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the Turn Aside Ambient Magic action.

 **Turn Aside Ambient Magic** <actions string="Single Action" /> (concentrate) Your ostilli glows a faint yellow as it establishes a barrier.

name: Defy Fey
summary: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic.

name: Desert Wind
trait: Air, Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Stance
summary: A vortex of sand and dust surrounds you.

name: Detonating Spell
trait: Cleric, Concentrate, Metamagic, Oracle, Sorcerer, Uncommon, Witch, Wizard
summary: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

name: Devout Blessing
summary: You gain the blessing of the devoted class feature

name: Directional Bombs
summary: You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines.

name: Dirge of Doom
summary: You learn the dirge of doom composition cantrip (page 370), which frightens your enemies and keeps them from fully recovering from their fear.

name: Disarming Intercept
summary: When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp.

name: Disarming Smile
summary: With a wide and sincere smile, you give your attacker pause.

name: Disarming Stance
summary: You adopt a fencing stance that improves your control over your weapon.

name: Discerning Gaze
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You have a sense for when people are lying.

name: Discerning Strike
summary: Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses.

name: Disciple of Shade
summary: You've delved deeper into the mysteries of shadow and become blessed with magical power that increases your skills in the arts of deception and persuasion.

name: Disk Rider
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _floating disk_
summary: When you cast _floating disk_, you can modify it to ride atop.

name: Disrupting Strikes
summary: You call forth positive energy from within to help you destroy undead.

name: Distracting Bites
summary: You know how to take advantage of those your swarm has attacked.

name: Diverting Vortex
summary: You use vestiges of magic to create a protective vortex.

name: Divine Emissary
prerequisite: a familiar, you follow a good-aligned deity or patron
summary: Your familiar is a divine emissary, sent to you by your deity or patron and infused with celestial powers.

name: Divine Rebuttal
summary: You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually.

name: Divine Weapon
summary: You siphon residual spell energy into a weapon you’re wielding.

name: Dodge Away
summary: You use your acrobatic prowess to evade an attack, using momentum to keep yourself moving if you choose.

name: Domain Spirit
summary: You forge an intense spiritual bond of mutual trust and appreciation with a single spirit that you have already bonded with using Bond with Spirit.

name: Draconic Familiar
summary: Your devotion to dragons has attracted a loyal servant.

name: Dragon Roar
summary: You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies.

name: Dragon's Rage Breath
summary: You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing 1d6 damage per level to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

name: Drenching Mist
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_
summary: When you cast _obscuring mist_, you can modify it to extinguish flames.

name: Drifter's Juke
summary: You move in and out of range to complement your attacks.

name: Driving Rain
summary: Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision.

name: Duel Spell Advantage
summary: When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell.

name: Echolocation
summary: When you take the Seek action, you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Educate Allies
summary: You tweak the properties of your composition spell to convey a bit of your defensive knowledge.

name: Efficient Preparation
summary: You’ve developed techniques for drilling your allies on multiple tactics in a succinct and efficient manner.

name: Eidolon's Opportunity
summary: Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature.

name: Eidolon's Wrath
summary: Your eidolon gains the _eidolon's wrath_ focus spell, which it casts, instead of you.

name: Eldritch Archer Dedication
prerequisite: expert in at least one weapon from the or bow or crossbow weapon group
summary: You channel powerful magic with your archery, allowing you to deliver potent spells through the tip of an arrow rather than the more mundane flick of the wrist or whatever other gestures are usually used.

name: Electrogenesis
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature deal electricity damage with an unarmed Strike or have identified a creature capable of dealing electricity damage with an unarmed Strike in combat
summary: Some animals and beasts have electric organs in their body that they can use to jolt their prey.

name: Elemental Artillery
trait: Attack, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal, Wood
summary: Spinning wood and metal together, you create a rugged wooden ballista.

name: Elemental Explosion
summary: You unleash the energy roiling within you.

name: Elysium's Cadence
prerequisite: You've partied extensively with an azata or entered a romantic relationship with an azata.
summary: You've been ensnared by an azata's infectious enthusiasm for life, love, and freedom.

name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Expert in Society; Emerald Boughs affiliation
summary: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context.

name: Endemic Herbs
summary: The herbal items you create use medicinal plants endemic to your location.

name: Energetic Resonance
summary: Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.

name: Energy Ward
summary: You convert energy from the last spell you cast into a protective ward.

name: Enervating Wail
summary: You release a terrible wail that tears at the spirits of all nearby.

name: Ensnaring Disarm
summary: You smack your foe's item out of their hand so that your student can grab it.

name: Essence Overflow
summary: Your Channel Draconic Essence ends, and all creatures (except you) in a 10-foot emanation from your spectral dragon take 6d6 damage with a

name: Exigent Aura
summary: The power of your deity and your own convictions leave an impression on creatures even when they normally would be unable to comprehend your words or the feelings spurred on by your god.

name: Expand Aura
summary: You focus your divine power to extend your influence and protection.

name: Expanded Elemental Magic
summary: You reach new understandings of the elements, taking an expansive view.

name: Expeditious Advance
summary: You advance and retreat quickly.

name: Expert Fireworks Crafter
prerequisite: Firework Technician Dedication; Expert in Crafting
summary: You’re particularly adept at crafting fireworks, allowing you to create more fireworks than you otherwise could.

name: Exploit Opening
summary: You take advantage of your spotter’s devastating attack to unleash your own follow-up attack.

name: Explosion
summary: Your innovation can explode on command.

name: Explosive Arrival
summary: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes.

name: Exsanguinate
summary: After one of your attacks, you direct your foe’s blood to spray upon you, infusing you with life energy.

name: Familiar's Resolve
summary: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt.

name: Far Throw
summary: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, you take only a –1 penalty for each additional range increment between you and the target, rather than a –2 penalty.

name: Fearful Symmetry
summary: You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly.

name: Fearsome Familiar
summary: Your elemental familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane.

name: Feeding Frenzy
summary: Your serrated teeth rip and tear at your prey.

name: Feeling Your Oats
prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Trained in Deception
summary: You are incredible, impeccable, an icon of style and grace—and everyone knows it.

name: Feverish Enzymes
summary: Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly.

name: Fey Tracker
summary: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice.

name: Field Artillery
summary: While castles are generally obliging enough to stay in one place, out in the field positioning is of paramount importance—a gun in the wrong place is worse than useless.

name: Five-breath Vanguard Dedication
prerequisite: Two of the five elemental stances (Ironblood Stance, Mountain Stance, Reflective Ripple Stance, Stoked Flame Stance, and Tangled Forest Stance)
summary: You flow like the elemental cycle, adapting your stance and techniques constantly in response to whatever circumstances you face.

name: Flair Rider Stance
prerequisite: Drake Rider Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics
summary: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks.

name: Fleeting Shadow
summary: You're able to quickly disappear and then move about without drawing the attention of your enemies.

name: Flexible Ritualist
summary: You can perform two aspects of a ritual yourself.

name: Fling Head
summary: You Interact to remove your head, if it isn’t already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body.

name: Flinging Updraft
summary: A speeding wind heeds your call, picking someone up and depositing them nearby.

name: Flow of War
summary: Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed.

name: Flowing Palm Deflection
summary: The simple and precise movements of your hands allow you to deflect blows with the same efficacy as a raised shield.

name: Fluttering Misdirection
summary: You’ve trained in drawing the eyes of your audience to specific aspects of your performance through the careful manipulation of your fans and body.

name: Follow-up Strike
summary: You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage.

name: Food Preservation
summary: Your techniques extend the storage life for certain ingredients and food through pickling, alcohol, or fermentation.

name: Forced Entry
prerequisite: Expert in Athletics; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You are trained to preserve the archaeological value of your location when entering.

name: Fortified Elixirs
summary: Your treatments for diseases and poisons can be very efficacious, though they tend not to last as long.

name: Fortune's Favor
summary: You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off.

name: Frighten Undead
prerequisite: Undead Slayer Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
summary: Your very presence chills creatures of the night down to their core and you can use the spiritual power and faithful life force of religious verses to frighten even mindless undead.

name: Frightful Condemnation
prerequisite: Harsh Judgment; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned.

name: Fulminating Shot
summary: You channel potent magic into your next shot, empowering it with a blast of crackling energy.

name: Fulu Familiar
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Expert in Occultism or Expert in Religion
summary: You can imprint your familiar’s spiritual essence into a fulu, a small paper charm that can be affixed to objects, creatures, or structures.

name: Fungal Exhalation
summary: You can conjure toxic spores to infect enemies.

name: Furious Focus
summary: You’ve learned to maintain your balance even when swinging furiously.

name: Gang Up
summary: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert.

name: Gear Up
summary: Whether it's wooden stakes, holy water, or more unusual tools, you always have just the right thing to handle an undead's unusual weaknesses and vulnerabilities.

name: Ghost Strike
summary: You can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead.

name: Ghostly Grasp (Ghost)
summary: Your control over your ghostly form grows.

name: Giant's Stature
summary: You grow to incredible size.

name: Gifted Power
summary: Your mystery grants you additional magic.

name: Gorilla Pound
summary: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes.

name: Grave Mummification
summary: Exposure to the elements, magic, alchemy, and other phenomena intensified the changes from your mummification.

name: Grave Sense
summary: Learn how to sense undead in the area.

name: Grave Strength
summary: The flesh you've consumed over the course of your existence as a ghoul has made you stronger, gifting you with strange insights from the minds of the sapient creatures you've devoured and bringing you closer to a state of undead perfection.

name: Gravel Guts
summary: Stone never becomes queasy, so why should you? You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the sickened condition.

name: Greater Lesson
summary: Your patron grants you greater knowledge.

name: Grown of Oak
summary: You can make your skin take on the woody endurance of an ancient tree and have your familiar follow suit.

name: Grudge Strike
summary: You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges.

name: Guarded Advance (Guardian)
summary: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

name: Guarded Mind
summary: When your enemies try to turn your mind against you, thoughts of your anathema bolster you.

name: Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)
summary: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.

name: Guardian's Intercept
summary: You can use the Intercept Attack reaction once per 10 minutes.

name: Guide the Timeline
summary: You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination.

name: Guided Skill
summary: You ask your spirit guide for aid.

name: Halcyon Speaker Dedication
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; member of the Magaambya of conversant rank
summary: You devote much of your study to halcyon magic.

name: Harbinger's Protection
summary: You often work on missions alone, making sure to cover up your weaknesses more effectively than other members of your faith.

name: Harmonize
summary: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously,

name: Harrow Ritualist
summary: You immediately learn two of the following rituals: _astral projection_, _call spirit_, _commune_, _commune with nature_, _legend lore_, or _planar binding_.

name: Heaven's Thunder
summary: With a loud shout, you unleash your ki in a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs your body.

name: Hedge Prison
summary: You cultivate plants to entrap your foes.

name: Hellknight Dedication
prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; lawful alignment; member of a Hellknight Order; passed the Hellknight Test
summary: You have forged your body to comply with the commands of your mind—orders steeped in the Measure and the Chain.

name: Hellknight Signifer Dedication
prerequisite: spellcasting class feature; Hellknight Armiger Dedication; lawful alignment; member of a Hellknight Order; passed the Hellknight Test
summary: You have bolstered your force of will with the power of the Measure and the Chain.

name: Hero-God's Bond
summary: At times, the myth of a hero-god includes a favored partner or a bonded ally, such as the hero-gods of promises and shield-bearers, Upion and Warrick.

name: Hey! Over Here!
summary: Hey! Don’t listen to that! That’s bad sounds! Listen to me!

name: High Alert
summary: You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around.

name: High-Speed Regeneration
summary: Your wounds knit together with barely a thought.

name: Hindquarter Kick
summary: You hold your prey's defensive limbs in place with your claws while delivering a swift kick to their unprotected sides.

name: Hit and Run
summary: Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating.

name: Holistic Care
summary: You provide emotional and spiritual care.

name: Illuminating Stories
summary: Stories serve as beacons in the night, illuminating valuable knowledge even if the tale itself misses the mark.

name: Implement Initiate
summary: Mastery of an implement is the sign of a studied thaumaturge.

name: Improved Familiar
summary: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

name: Inertial Barrier
summary: Your spell leaves behind barriers that reduce shock and motion.

name: Inexorable
summary: You imbue yourself with the resilience of the cave worm.

name: Infiltrate Dream
summary: Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway.

name: Infiltrator's Reload
prerequisite: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication; Expert in Stealth
summary: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration.

name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
summary: Your tattoos immortalize the conquests of orc war leaders, such as Belkzen besieging the dwarven Sky Citadel of Koldukar.

name: Inner Fire (SoM)
summary: While you're in Stoked Flame Stance, you have cold and fire resistance, and any creature touches you takes fire damage.

name: Inner Strength
summary: Your strength is part of your rage.

name: Inscribed with Elders' Deeds
summary: Your tattoos commemorate unique exploits that (according to legends) only an orc could accomplish.

name: Insect Shape
summary: Your understanding of life expands, allowing you to mimic a wider range of creatures.

name: Instinct Ability
summary: Your rage stokes the spark of your barbarian instinct into a roaring flame.

name: Instinctive Support
summary: When you support your animal companion, your companion supports you in turn.

name: Intensified Element Stance
summary: You expend the elemental medicine in your body to empower your attacks, though you can’t consume any more elemental medicine until the next day.

name: Interrogate
summary: You ask questions you know will be answered.

name: Intimidating Spell
summary: The devastation wrought by your large-scale spells is particularly terrifying.

name: Invented Vulnerability
summary: You list off the potential fears and weaknesses of an enemy you can see or hear, speaking with such certainty that they  become real.

name: Invigorating Mercy
summary: Your divine touch rejuvenates the weak and tired.

name: Invincible Army
summary: You enumerate the many virtues and victories of your chosen allies, creating a story of their invincibility so convincing that  it is as good as the truth.

name: Irradiate
summary: You exude an aura of radiation, making everyone around you ill.

name: Irresistible Magic
summary: You’ve studied ways of overcoming the innate defenses against magic that dragons, otherworldly beings, and certain other powerful creatures have.

name: It's Alive!
summary: You've mastered the use of electrical energy to power your clockwork creations.

name: Jagged Berms
trait: Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Wood
summary: You conjure up to six cube-shaped mounds of packed earth.

name: Jelly Body
prerequisite: You've been reduced to 0 Hit Points while engulfed by an ooze.
summary: Some of the ooze that surrounded you made its way permanently into parts of your body, turning you soft to the touch and semitransparent enough to show bones.

name: Keen Recollection
summary: You can recall all sorts of information.

name: Keep Pace
summary: When your hunted prey tries to bolt, you follow.

name: Keep Pace
summary: Once you are upon your prey, they can’t escape.

name: Ki Cutting Sight
summary: Everything is connnected—all is part of the whole. Find where to add your ki and you can break the whole.

name: Kinetic Dampening
summary: You feed off energy in your immediate surroundings, allowing you to dampen the force imparted by incoming blows.

name: Knight Reclaimant Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival; any non-evil alignment; member of the Knights of Lastwall of knight rank
summary: You have sworn the Crimson Oath and become a full member of the Crimson Reclaimers.

name: Knight Vigilant
prerequisite: Trained in Religion; any good alignment; member of the Knights of Lastwall of knight rank
summary: You are dedicated to the cause of the Shining Sentinels.

name: Lesson of Bonded Eyes
summary: You and your student share an understanding of your surroundings.

name: Let my Creature Live!
summary: You continue to tinker with your creation’s muscles and rudimentary mind, granting it a limited form of autonomy.

name: Leverage Anguish
summary: You leverage your emotional turmoil to mend your physical form.

name: Liberate Soul
summary: The light flows from your sigil of Pharasma to shatter the bonds imprisoning a soul.

name: Light Step
summary: You aren’t bothered by tricky footing.

name: Lightning Rod
trait: Air, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal
summary: You smash a metal rod into your foe and call lightning to it.

name: Litany Against Wrath
summary: You excoriate a foe for its wrath against goodly creatures.

name: Living Rune
summary: You’ve bridged a connection between the runes on your body and the magic of runestones, allowing you to place an armor rune on your living flesh.

name: Lock Down
summary: You attack an enemy to ensure they can't move beyond your reach.

name: Lotus Above the Mud
summary: Your qi, dancing ever diligently toward cultivation, eludes the grasp of the world’s muck and mire.

name: Loyal Warhorse
summary: The loyalty you and your mount share is unbreakable.

name: Macabre Virtuoso
prerequisite: Reanimator Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
summary: Any necromancer can create zombie and skeleton, but you know the secrets behind the creation of far more advanced undead monstrosities.

name: Mage Hunter
summary: You use your hatred of magic to lash out at a known spellcaster.

name: Magic Hands
summary: The blessing of your deity heightens your healing ability, integrating magical healing with the mundane.

name: Magical Scrounger
summary: You can craft a temporary wondrous item using the magic scrounged from all around.

name: Mammoth Charge
summary: You Command an Animal to order your megafauna companion to Stride twice.

name: Master Summoner
summary: During daily preparations, you can designate one of your spell slots to become two summoning slots of the same spell level, from which you can cast only summoning or incarnate spells.

name: Masterful Warden
summary: Your mastery of warden magic increases.

name: Mastermind's Eye
summary: When you identify a creature with Recall Knowledge, that creature is flat-footed to you.

name: Mature Animal Companion (Ranger)
summary: Your animal companion becomes a mature animal companion and gains additional capabilities (page 211).

name: Mature Megafauna Companion
summary: You've raised your megafauna companion to be a more powerful force on the battlefield than most of its kind.

name: Mature Trained Companion
summary: Your animal companion grows up, becoming a mature animal companion.

name: Medium's Awareness
summary: Your apparitions watch over you.

name: Megafauna Veterinarian
prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Expert in Nature
summary: By heeding the wise advice of elders in your following— and aided by your own experience—you've learned how to provide medical care to the megafauna of the Mammoth Lord followings.

name: Megavolt
summary: You bleed off some electric power from your innovation in the shape of a damaging bolt.

name: Mesmerizing Gaze
summary: When you meet someone’s gaze, they’re unable to look away from you.

name: Mind Shards
summary: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind.

name: Misty Transformation
summary: Wild mists cover your form.

name: Mobile Swarm
summary: The clicking of fast-moving legs accompanies your swarm in all kinds of environments.

name: Molten Wire
trait: Attack, Composite, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal
summary: Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires.

name: Momentous Charge
summary: You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force.

name: Motionless Cutter
summary: Your weapon is so sharp even an insect alighting upon its still blade would be severed.

name: Mountain Stronghold
summary: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you.

name: Mounted Shield
summary: You’ve trained with your shield to defend both yourself and your mount.

name: Multifaceted Will
summary: Without the firm hand of a patron, your power begins to reflect deeper complexities, sometimes latching onto entirely unexpected sources of magical potency.

name: Mummy's Despair
trait: Archetype, Aura, Divine, Emotion, Enchantment, Fear, Mental
summary: You force your mental anguish outward, projecting it upon those around you.

name: Munitions Machinist
summary: You're particularly adept at crafting ammunition and bombs.

name: Nameless Anonymity
summary: Your mask protects you further from divination.

name: Narrative Conduit
summary: You act as a conduit for your companions just as your stories are a conduit between teller and listener.

name: Nature Prowler
summary: When you begin your turn hidden or unnoticed by your hunted prey, that creature is off-guard to you until the end of your turn.

name: Nature's Precision
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an agile or finesse unarmed attack
summary: Your companions pick at an enemy's weak points.

name: Necrologist Dedication
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots, ability to cast _summon undead_
summary: Your studies of the lists of the dead allow you to call forth a horde of undead with a brief incantation.

name: Night's Glow
summary: The stars and moon lend you their light.

name: Nightwave Springing Reload
summary: Training with the crew of the Nightwave has taught you their technique for reloading while leaping to board another ship.

name: Nimble Shield Hand
summary: You are so used to wielding a shield that you can do so even while using the hand that’s holding it for other tasks that require the dexterity of a hand.

name: No Hard Feelings
summary: Despite the devastation your weapons tend to inflict upon their targets or the destruction you might unleash upon an area, your foes still manage to walk away at the end of a fight—at least sometimes.

name: Nocturnal Senses
summary: Your senses gain even greater clarity.

name: Numb
summary: As your body continues to rot and putrefy, your senses deaden and your undead powers grow.

name: Obscured Terrain
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_
summary: When you cast _obscuring mist_, you can modify the spell to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground.

name: One More Activation
summary: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual.

name: One-inch Punch
summary: You put all your force into a single mighty, carefully controlled blow.

name: Oppurtune Trickster
summary: You aren’t above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack.

name: Ostentatious Arrival
summary: If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a three-action summoning Spell, the creature appears in an explosion.

name: Pack Attack
summary: You have mastered techniques for hunting alongside your pack.

name: Pact of Draconic Fury
summary: You've sworn a pact with a dragon, giving you the ability to tap into the dragon's immeasurable power in exchange for adding to their hoard.

name: Pain Tolerance
summary: You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you clumsy, drained, or enfeebled.

name: Palatine Enchantment
summary: You have found yourself facing supernatural beings often and have learned how to combat them.

name: Parallel Breakthrough
summary: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty.

name: Perfect Ki Adept
summary: You gain the appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection.

name: Perfect Truths
summary: Your knowledge of Razmir’s faith and doctrines has grown.

name: Performative Weapons Training
summary: You're skilled with flashy weapons and can use them to great effect.

name: Perpetual Scout
summary: You spot anything out of place in the areas you know best.

name: Phalanx Breaker
summary: You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center.

name: Phase Out
summary: Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force and negative) equal to half your level.

name: Pirouette
summary: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack.

name: Pistolero's Challenge
summary: With a stern call, carefully chosen barb, or some other challenging declaration, you demand your foe's attention in a duel.

name: Piston Punch
summary: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row.

name: Plague Rat
summary: Your bites carry a cursed infection.

name: Poison Coat
summary: In nature, certain animals are covered in venomous spines, and just brushing against them can prove deadly.

name: Poisoned Sticks and Stones
summary: You prepare your sling stones with small, edged grooves to enable them to deliver poison, and you have learned other  techniques for poisoning your weapons.

name: Polearm Tricks
summary: Your connection to rune magic has revealed tricks to make polearms deadlier in your hands.

name: Powerful Lash
summary: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs.

name: Practiced Opposition
summary: You've battled more undead than you care to remember, often with little time to prepare between foes, forcing you to rely on experience and muscle memory to guide your blade.

name: Precise Finisher
summary: Even when your foe avoids your Confident Finisher, you can still hit a vital spot.

name: Predatory Claws
summary: Your nails grow into sharp claws, perfect for seizing and tearing your prey.

name: Predictive Purchase
summary: You have just the thing for the situation.

name: Primal Proportions
summary: You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts.

name: Propulsive Mutation
summary: Your ostilli can fire its dart farther.

name: Psi Development
summary: You’ve found a new mental form

name: Quick Snares
summary: You can rig a snare in only moments.

name: Rain-Scribe Sustenance
summary: You use the power of your Rain-Scribe magic to draw on a stream of primal power for sustenance.

name: Rallying Charge
summary: Your fearless charge into battle reinvigorates your allies to carry on the fight.

name: Rapid Manifestation
summary: Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you're in danger.

name: Reactive Strike
trait: Barbarian, Champion, Commander, Exemplar, Guardian, Magus, Swashbuckler
summary: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

name: Read the Dust
summary: You watch the creature or hazard as it collapses, careful for any sign it may return.

name: Red Mantis School Spell
summary: You gain the Red Mantis magic school’s initial school spell.

name: Reflexive Shield
summary: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

name: Relentless Disarm
prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Athletics
summary: You have been trained to disarm foes.

name: Reloading Trick
summary: You can fire off a single shot even when it seems like you are unprepared.

name: Remote Trigger
summary: You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

name: Repeat Lesson
summary: Upon seeing your student falter, you demonstrate the proper technique.

name: Repulse the Wicken
summary: You use your foe's failure as an opening to push them away.

name: Resourceful Ritualist
summary: You can cast difficult rituals  that might otherwise be just beyond your skill.

name: Retaliating Rescue
summary: When an ally is in danger, you can hustle to reach them and punish the foe threatening them.

name: Return Fire
summary: Snatching an arrow out of the air, you instantly put it to your bow and return fire.

name: Revealing Stab
summary: You drive your piercing weapon into an imperceptible foe, revealing its location to your allies.

name: Ricochet Stance (Fighter)
summary: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

name: Riddle the Sphinx
summary: You’ve learned the secrets of the sphinx’s riddles and empowered your ikon with them.

name: Ring their Bell
summary: Using your armor, you pummel a foe that isn't focused on you in the head or face to stagger them.

name: Rising Hurricane
trait: Air, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Water
summary: A hurricane lifts your enemies into the air before bringing them crashing down in a bloody rain.

name: Roaring Heart
summary: You surge forward inexorably.

name: Rod of Rule
summary: Your personal rune is connected more closely to your arcane bond.

name: Roiling Mudslide
trait: Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Water
summary: You form water and earth into a mudslide that smashes your opponents and coats them in mud.

name: Rough Terrain Stance
summary: You enter a stance that makes it difficult to move around you.

name: Rushing Boar
summary: You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush.

name: Sacred Armaments
summary: Through the power of your faith or the blessing of a priest, your weapons are fully effective against incorporeal creatures.

name: Safeguard Spell
summary: You are inured to the effects of your own spells.

name: Sand Snatcher
summary: A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet.

name: Say that Again!
summary: The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you—put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a Shove attempt against that opponent.

name: Scatter Blast
summary: You pack your weapon with additional shot and powder, creating a risky but devastating wave of destruction.

name: Scholarly Defense
summary: Your knowledge of strange creatures and their bizarre anatomy allows you to anticipate their physical attacks and reduce the damage you take from them.

name: Scouring Rage
prerequisite: an instinct that allows you to change your additional damage from Rage to a different damage type
summary: You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger.

name: Scout's Speed
summary: You move faster, especially when traveling, allowing you to scout out ahead and report back without slowing your allies.

name: Scrap Barricade
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Metal, Overflow, Primal
summary: Ragged pieces of metal weld together into a ramshackle structure.

name: Scroll Esoterica
summary: Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls.

name: Scrollmaster Dedication
prerequisite: expert in any Lore skill; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Scrolls
summary: Your experience chronicling adventures and discoveries grants you heightened discernment and memory.

name: Second Shield
summary: You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself.

name: Selective Energy
summary: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt.

name: Share Burden
summary: You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state.

name: Shatter Defenses
summary: Your offense exploits your enemy’s fear.

name: Shield of Stone
summary: You stole a gorgon’s gaze and trapped it in your ikon.

name: Shield Wall
summary: You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade.

name: Shield Warden
summary: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

name: Shielded Tome
summary: During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse a shield into your favorite book, where it appears as an elaborate bookmark.

name: Shove Down
summary: You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move.

name: Siege Celerity
summary: You push yourself and your light mortar  beyond your limits.

name: Silk Bracelet
prerequisite: armor innovation, construct innovation, or weapon innovation
summary: Taking inspiration from Desna’s image as a giant silk moth in Tian Xia, you’ve attached a bracelet to your innovation that generates ultra-strong silk strands mixed with venom.

name: Simple Crystal Magic
summary: You are capable of seeing magic as flowing runes and can scribe a personal rune that represents you.

name: Sinbladed Spell

summary: You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time.

name: Boost Summons
summary: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon.

name: Brain Drain
summary: With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own.

name: Bravo's Determination
prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
summary: Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds.

name: Breath of the Dragon
summary: You can use a powerful breath weapon, much like the dragon you emulate.

name: Bullet Split
summary: You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets.

name: Bullseye
summary: You carefully take aim to avoid your foe’s concealment and cover.

name: Call and Response
summary: Your composition takes the form of a call-and-response chant that lets your allies continue the effect without you.

name: Call Gun
summary: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow, gaining the ability to conjure it directly to your hand from any distant location.

name: Call the Hurricane
summary: Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane.

name: Call Ursine Ally
summary: You can cast a 3rd-rank _summon animal_ as an innate spell, but only to summon a black bear.

name: Call Your Shot
summary:
When you successfully Play to the Crowd, add the following to the list of benefits you can choose from:
  • A creature you can see within 30 feet becomes frightened 2.

name: Calm and Centered
summary: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being frightened or stupefied.

name: Can't You See?
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; Expert in Stealth
summary: The eye rebels, the mind recoils—no matter how much those who can see you try to explain what's there, their friends' gazes just skitter over you, like a bird afraid to land.

name: Capture Magic
summary: When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use.

name: Carried with the Swarm
summary: When your swarm is sharing your space and Strides, you can choose to have your swarm carry you with it.

name: Chaining Mutation
summary: The dart fired by your ostilli can ricochet to strike another creature.

name: Challenge Insight
summary: Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power.

name: Chaotic Spell
trait: Bard, Manipulate, Metamagic, Oracle, Sorcerer, Uncommon, Witch, Wizard
summary: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

name: Chronomancer's Secrets
summary: The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths.

name: Clinging Shadows Initiate
summary: You learn a mystical stance that transforms your qi into sticky smoke that shrouds your limbs.

name: Clue Them All In
summary: You can clue in all your allies at once.

name: Conductive Sphere
trait: Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Metal, Primal
summary: A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity.

name: Constricting Hold
summary: Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon's level plus its Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.

name: Controlled Blast
summary: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously.

name: Cornered Animal
summary: You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies.

name: Counter Curse
summary: You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it.

name: Countercharm
summary: Your enchantments and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others.

name: Creed Magic
summary: You’ve expanded your divine capabilities, granting you magic that better supports your combat focus.

name: Cremate Undead
summary: Your overwhelming vitality sets undead alight.

name: Crossblooded Evolution
summary: Odd interactions in your bloodline provide you with unexpected effects.

name: Crosscurrent Counter
summary: You counter the creature with the power of elemental water, a tendril of it encasing your limb or weapon.

name: Crude Communication
summary: Even if you don’t speak a creature’s language, you can rely on inflection, root words, and body language to infer rudimentary meaning.

name: Cultivator's Keen Eye
summary: Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

name: Cursed Effigy
summary: After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body.

name: Cyclonic Ascent
summary: Whorls of wind surround your lower body, forming a cyclone that lifts you into the air.

name: Dark Persona's Presence
summary: When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain—the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution—come along with it.

name: Deadly Aim
summary: You aim for your prey’s weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit.

name: Deadly Butterfly
summary: You gain access to the butterfly sword's critical specialization effect.

name: Deadly Mutation
summary: The dart fired by your ostilli is more dangerous.

name: Death from Above
prerequisite: Canopy Predator; Verduran Shadow Dedication; Expert in Athletics
summary: You leap down on your target, using their body to cushion your fall and your momentum to empower your attack.

name: Debilitating Dichotomy
summary: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well.

name: Deeper Dabbler
summary: With some streamlining to your process and a deeper collection of  <%CONSUMABLES%19%> talisman <%END> materials, you make a greater number of talismans every day.

name: Defensive Stratagem
summary: By scrutinizing a foe, you learn how to better avoid its attacks.

name: Defiant Banner
summary: You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure.

name: Deimatic Display
summary: Imitating animal threat displays, you make yourself appear larger and more imposing.

name: Delay Trap
summary: You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects.

name: Disarming Assault
summary: You attack with enough force to knock the weapon out of your foe's hands.

name: Dismal Harvest
summary: The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power.

name: Disorienting Opening
summary: You use your foes’ openings to expose even greater weaknesses.

name: Distracting Toss
