summary: You toss one weapon into the air as a distraction as you throw another.

name: Diverse Recognition
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; master in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
summary: Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats.

name: Divine Breadth
summary: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day.

name: Divine Healing
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Expert in Religion; worship a deity with a divine font that grants _heal_
summary: Although you aren't a proper champion of your faith, your deity still recognizes your efforts and provides you with a small divine ability to help others.

name: Dream Magic
summary: You learn dream-related magic to aid your studies.

name: Drifting Pollen
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Stance, Wood
summary: A haze of pollen floats around you.

name: Drive Back
summary: You push the enemy back and attempt to intercede between the foe and your ally.

name: Dual Finisher
summary: You split your attacks.

name: Dualistic Synergy
summary: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit.

name: Dueling Riposte
summary: You elegantly counterattack against your flailing enemy.

name: Duo's Aim
summary: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack.

name: Ears of the Forest
summary: Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings.

name: Eclectic Skill
summary: Your broad experiences translate to a range of skills.

name: Eerie Environs
prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Stealth
summary: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still.

name: Eerie Traces
prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Survival
summary: The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through.

name: Efficient Rituals
summary: You can perform particularly extensive rituals  in less time.

name: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica
summary: As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans.

name: Elemental Overlap
summary: Though you've dedicated yourself to one element, you learn to mix that element with another.

name: Elude the Divine
summary: You are able to escape inquisitions involving divine magic, allowing you to blend in well in Mzali but also to avoid unwanted attention in other oppressive theocracies.

name: Emblazon Energy
summary: With elemental forces, you make your emblazoned symbols more potent.

name: Enchanting Shot
summary: With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

name: Energy Resistance
summary: Your eidolon has stronger resistance.

name: Enhanced Psychopomp Familiar
summary: Your psychopomp's continued service in Pharasma's name brings it favor from the goddess.

name: Environmental Adaptability
summary: Having experienced the harshest environs that nature has to offer, your body is able to adapt to intense heat and cold.

name: Equitable Defense
summary: Gritting your teeth through the pain, you position yourself to counterattack.

name: Explosion of Power
summary: Your magic explodes.

name: Exude Demonic Corruption
prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a demon
summary: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others.

name: Faithful Stride
summary: Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride).

name: Familiar Form
summary: You can use your magic to transform into a small creature of a type that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar, potentially allowing you to safely scout for your party while retaining a degree of spellcasting ability.

name: Familiar Ritualist
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; ability to cast a ritual
summary: Your familiar’s magical presence can serve as an aspect of a ritual.

name: Feathered Flechettes
summary: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions.

name: Feline Dance
summary: You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging.

name: Felling Strike
summary: Your attack can ground an airborne foe.

name: Feral Mending
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were not afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
summary: You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh.

name: Ferocious Shape
summary: You’ve mastered the shape of dinosaurs.

name: Fey Caller
summary: You have learned some of the tricks the fey use to bend primal magic toward illusions and trickery.

name: Fey's Trickery
prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a fey
summary: You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight.

name: Fiery Retort
summary: Ignoring your pain, you sear your attacker with a wave of flame.

name: Flamboyant Cruelty
summary: You love to kick your enemies when they're down, and you look fabulous when you do.

name: Flashing Shield
prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity
summary: Your shield flares with holy light as you block the attack, searing the undead with the power of your faith.

name: Flashy Roll
summary: You can use Flashy Dodge before attempting a Reflex save, in addition to its original trigger.

name: Flensing Slice
summary: When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot.

name: Flickering Stories
summary: Stories, like fires, can create shadows as much as they illuminate.

name: Floral Restoration
summary: You request that nearby plants share their vitality with you to replenish your body and magic.

name: Follow-up Assault
summary: Even in the face of failure you press the attack, determined to succeed.

name: Foolproof Instructions
summary: You feel confident that you can explain your scrolls so well that even your allies can use them.

name: Forgotten Presence
summary: The world conspires to keep you forgotten and unnoticed— memories cloud, ink stains out your name in ledgers, and portraits of you crack and warp over your face.

name: Form Retention
summary: You have trained your mind and body to tolerate polymorph magic for longer periods of time, so long as you prepare for the change appropriately.

name: Fortified Flesh
summary: Your flesh is resistent to physical damage.

name: Fortissimo Composition
summary: Your anthems grow louder and more potent, bolstered by your muse’s power.

name: Forward Gaze into Life
trait: Concentrate, Divine, Exemplar, Uncommon, Vitality, Void
summary: Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life.

name: Friendly Toss
summary: You toss your friends around the battlefield.

name: Frozen Breadth
summary: Your attunement to arcane cold enhances the depths of your growing power.

name: Furious Bully
summary: You bully foes across the battlefield.

name: Fused Staff
summary: When you prepare a staff, you can hold it up to a weapon to merge the two items.

name: Future Spell Learning
summary: More future memories of time magic percolate back to the present, teaching you spells you've yet to learn.

name: Garden Path
summary: You can guide your crop to move without notice.

name: Gardener's Resolve
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: The Gray Gardeners are known for having nerves of steel and an unbreakable resolve.

name: Ghost Flight
summary: You can suppress your tether to the ground, overcoming your resistance to fly free.

name: Gigaton Strike
summary: When you use a full-power Megaton Strike, you can knock your foe back.

name: Glitter Crystals
summary: You can mix a blend of crushed flowers and alchemical salt into an alchemical elixir with the healing trait or alchemical food.

name: Glyph Expert
summary: You've learned to recognize the telltale writings and other signs that indicate the presence of magical traps.

name: Gods' Palm
summary: You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy’s physical defenses.

name: Golden Dragon's Bounty
summary: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal.

name: Golden League Xun Dedication
summary: You are a xun for the Golden League, aiding the organization.

name: Golem Grafter Dedication
prerequisite: expert in Arcana and Crafting, or an ally with expert proficiency in those skills willing to augment you
summary: Your flesh has been specially treated with the same arcane and alchemical processes used to toughen the skin of flesh golems.

name: Grand Dance
summary: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance.

name: Grasping Corpses
summary: Your foes are left reeling from the attacks made by the zombies or skeletons of your horde.

name: Great Boaster
summary: Your bragging is particularly effective.

name: Greater Cruelty
summary: The extent of your corruption devastates your foes' minds and reflexes.

name: Greater Mercy
summary: Your faith enhances your ability to remove conditions.

name: Greater Security
summary: Shield in hand, you offer your ally its full protection you do yourself.

name: Greenwatch Veteran
summary: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies.

name: Grievous Blow
summary: You know how to deliver focused, powerful blows that bypass your enemies’ resistances.

name: Grit and Tenacity
summary: You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect.

name: Group Taunt
summary: Your taunts draw the attention of multiple enemies at once.

name: Guardian Ghosts
summary: You magically divert some of the harm from an incoming attack away from yourself, forcing your undead companion to take it in your stead.

name: Guardian Lion Roar
prerequisite: armor innovation, construct innovation, or weapon innovation
summary: Your innovation is augmented with plates shaped to resemble the gaping maws of guardian lions, which you can energize to expel a stream of sonic energy reminiscent of a lion’s powerful roar.

name: Guardian's Embrace
summary: Your spirit guide discorporates to surround you in an invisible protective shroud.

name: Hamstringing Strike
summary: You slow your foes with a well-aimed attack.

name: Harbinger's Armament
summary: Your deity grants you extra power that you have learned to channel into your weapons.

name: Haunting Memories
summary: Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the _final blade_ from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories.

name: Hazard Finder
summary: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards.

name: Heal Mount
summary: Your devotion to your mount manifests as a surge of vital energy.

name: Heightened Captivation
summary: You can infuse your enchantments and illusions with more power.

name: Hell's Bane
summary: Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when fighting against them.

name: Helt's Spelldance
summary: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.

name: Hot Foot
summary: Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature “dance.”

name: Hulking Size
summary: Your eidolon grows substantially.

name: Ilverani Purist
summary: All twilight speakers are trained to resist the alluring customs of younger peoples, but you have made it your mandate to keep the Ilverani way unchanged.

name: Impassable Wall Stance
summary: You refuse to let foes past your guard.

name: Impenetrable Fog
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal, Water
summary: Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you.

name: Impervious Vehicle
summary: From armor plating and flexible components, to reinforced materials and backup redundant functionality, you have built safeguards to protect your vehicle from the rigors of combat.

name: Improved Command Corpse
summary: When you use Command Undead on a mindless undead, if the undead succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it becomes your minion for 1 round.

name: Improved Elemental Blast
summary: The power of your elemental blast improves.

name: Improved Invigorating Elixir
summary: Choose physical invigoration or mental invigoration, and add the listed conditions to those you can choose for an invigorating elixir.

name: Improved Poison Weapon
summary: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects.

name: Improvised Crafting
summary: You've learned to repair your equipment even in challenging circumstances, making use of what you have available.

name: Improvised Critical
summary: You can apply critical specialization effects to improvised weapons you wield.

name: Incredible Aim
summary: By spending a moment to focus, you can ensure your attack strikes true.

name: Incredible Beastmaster Companion
summary: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop.

name: Incredible Companion (Druid)
summary: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

name: Incredible Construct Companion
summary: Thanks to your continual tinkering, your construct companion has advanced to an astounding new stage of engineering, enhancing all its attributes.

name: Incredible Dragon Companion
summary: Your mature dragon companion develops further, becoming more robust and formidable.

name: Incredible Familiar
summary: Your familiar is imbued with even more magic than other familiars.

name: Incredible Megafauna Companion
summary: Under your care and training, your megafauna companion has realized its innate potential.

name: Incredible Mount
summary: Under your care and training, your mount has realized its innate potential.

name: Incredible Reanimated Companion
summary: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities.

name: Innate Magic Intuition
summary: You've spent countless hours learning to recognize and predict a creature's innate magical abilities.

name: Insistent Command
prerequisite: Master in Nature; Animal Trainer Dedication
summary: When you roll a success to Command an Animal, you get a critical success.

name: Inspired Stratagem
summary: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems for the day’s adventures with up to five allies.

name: Instinctive Maneuvers
summary: When you allow an apparition control over your body, it might vent its fury against your foes.

name: Instinctive Strike
summary: You trust your instincts and your sense of smell, using all your senses to pinpoint your opponent's location.

name: Interposing Crowd
summary: Your enemies can’t stop you when there’s a host of people between you.

name: Interrupt Charge
summary: You attempt to snag the foe before they run away.

name: Into the Fray
summary: You charge into battle with shield-splintering fury.

name: Invoke Defense
summary: You manifest a defensive quality of spirits all around, such as the thick hide of an animal spirit or the sturdy bark of a nature spirit.

name: Invoke the Crimson Oath
summary: You can invoke the Crimson Oath to unleash blasts of ruby energy from your weapon.

name: Invulnerable Rager
summary: Even the heaviest armors serve only to enhance your unbridled fury.

name: Ironblood Stance
summary: You enter the stance of impenetrable iron, refusing to yield to any blow.

name: Jellyfish Stance
summary: You relax your posture and loosen your joints, allowing yourself to move with incredible fluidity.

name: Juggernaut Charge
summary: As you move forward in a rush, you put the weight of your armor behind an attack that can drag a foe with you.

name: Jumping Jenny Display
summary: This multi-sequence rocket blasts confetti at a series of altitudes.

name: Kaiju Stance
summary: Your encounter with one of the rare forces of nature known as kaiju has imbued you with knowledge of a martial art that allows you to emulate a fraction of their power.

name: Kaleidoscopic Entreaty
summary: If your next action is to cast entreat spirit, you can cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a 10-foot emanation centered on you.

name: Kindle Inner Flames
summary: As a candle can light another, you awaken the latent potential to channel fire in other creatures.

name: Knight's Retaliation
summary: You knock the enemy's blow aside and twist, unbalancing your foe.

name: Know Your Enemy
summary: You aim to turn knowledge into power against your foes.

name: Know-It-All
summary: When you Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context.

name: Knowledge is Power
summary: Your academic knowledge about a creature allows you to subtly alter your magic to defeat them.

name: Larcenous Hand
summary: When you cast _mage hand_, you can modify it to steal an object from the target.

name: Lead by Example
summary: You telegraph your next attack to let your allies in on your strategy.

name: Leap and Fire
summary: You're quick enough to line up a shot even while diving to the ground.

name: Lesson of Mutual Gambits
summary: You create an opening for your student, setting them up for their own attack.

name: Lesson of Sympathetic Vulnerability
summary: You temporarily borrow the essence of your student's attack to infuse yourself.

name: Lethargy Poisoner
prerequisite: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication; Trained in Crafting
summary: You've learned more than the use of hand crossbows.

name: Levered Swing
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; Master in Athletics
summary: You can wrap your lash around a tree branch or railing, then pull yourself where you need to go.

name: Levering Strike
summary: Strike your foe and make them unbalanced

name: Lightning Rings' Intervention
summary: Your familiar learns to empower spells with an electrical discharge.

name: Lingering Flames
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify its effects to set creatures in its area aflame.

name: Lion's Fury
summary: You gain access to the lion scythe's and sun sling's critical specialization effects.

name: Lion's Magic
summary: Many Lion Blades enhance their words with a bit of magic.

name: Live Ammunition
summary: There are generally few things as ill-advised as being shot out of a cannon or launched by a trebuchet, but people use the tactic every so often in a desperate situation.

name: Living for the Applause
summary: Nothing can stop you as long as you have an audience cheering you on.

name: Loaner Spell
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: During your daily preparations, you can gain the assistance of an allied prepared spellcaster to prepare one spell for the day.

name: Lobbed Attack
summary: Make an unexpected ranged attack with a Juggled item.

name: Lore Seeker
summary: You see what others don’t, and you’ve developed magical tricks to find hidden truth.

name: Lorefinder
summary: You know that fate sometimes conspires to keep dangerous knowledge or items from the eyes of those most able to understand them.

name: Magic Ammunition
summary: You imbue your ammunition with raw and potent magic, transforming it to suit your needs in any situation.

name: Magic Finder
summary: You've learned a few tricks to ensure you find every last magic item and interesting magical effect during your missions.

name: Magical Adept
summary: Your eidolon gains more magic.

name: Magical Knowledge
prerequisite: Thaumaturge Dedication; trained in at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion and expert in at least one other
summary: Increase your proficiency rank in one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion.

name: Majestic Proclamation
summary: You announce your name to your enemies, bringing your constellation to bear in a blinding display.

name: Makeshift Strike
summary: You quickly snatch up whatever is nearby and then attack with it as an improvised weapon.

name: Malleable Mental Forge
summary: You open your mind to further weapon customization.

name: Manifold Modifications
summary: You've modified your innovation using clever workarounds, so you can include another initial modification without compromising its structure.

name: Mantis Form
summary: You gain the _mantis form_ focus spell

name: Many Guises
summary: You can take on any number of mundane guises.

name: Martyr
summary: You go to extreme lengths to support your allies, even when it means bringing harm to yourself.

name: Martyr's Parry
summary: You intercede to absorb the triggering attack.

name: Masked Casting
summary: You harness the magical energy flowing through your eyeless mask to effortlessly protect you from visual effects.

name: Mental Static
summary: Your thoughts sting back when a lesser mind tries to invade your own.

name: Metabolize Element
summary: Your rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy.

name: Mighty Bulwark
summary: Thanks to the incredible connection you have forged with your armor, you can use it to shrug off an extensive array of dangers.

name: Mind Projectiles
summary: You've learned to stretch your mind's influence further, releasing projectiles with a swing of your mind weapon.

name: Miniaturize
summary: Your eidolon can shrink even further.

name: Minor Omen
summary: The stars warn you of danger in the nick of time.

name: Mixed Maneuver
summary: You leverage your knowledge of martial arts to mix different maneuvers together into a single flowing combination.

name: Mobile Shot Stance
summary: Your shots become nimble and deadly.

name: Monk Moves
summary: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed when you’re not wearing armor.

name: Monumental Maestro
summary: You’ve studied the moving compositions of Andreas Romung, a legendary maestro whose Shining Crusade anthems live on in the music for the play _Echoes of Glory_.

name: Murksight
summary: Your vision pierces through non-magical fog, mist, rain, and snow.

name: Mutable Familiar
summary: Your familiar's supernatural spirit has outgrown its corporeal body.

name: Mutant Physique
summary: Basic mutagens that affect your physical form can bring out the beast within you, turn you nigh invincible, or make your body more elastic.

name: Mysterious Breadth
summary: Increase the spell slots you gain from oracle archetype feats

name: Necromantic Bulwark
summary: Regular exposure to necromantic effects left you better able to defend against them.

name: Necromantic Tenacity
summary: Reduce the power that necromantic effects hold over you.

name: Nimble Roll
summary: You throw yourself into a roll to escape imminent danger.

name: Nothing Personal
summary: When you’re on a job, you can’t allow anyone to stop you.

name: Occult Breadth
summary: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more occult spells each day.

name: Officer's Education
summary: You know that a broad knowledge base is critical for a competent commander.

name: Ooze Empathy
prerequisite: Oozemorph Dedication; at least two other class feats from the oozemorph archetype
summary: You can connect with oozes (and other amorphous aberrations, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.

name: Opportune Backstab
summary: When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction.

name: Opportunistic Grapple
summary: You use an opening to capture your prey.

name: Orator's Fillibuster
summary: When you seek to convince others of the worth of your cause, you are capable of unleashing such an entrancing torrent of rhetoric and metaphor that it is all but impossible to look away from you.

name: Order Training
summary: You gain the lesser order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

name: Ore Fists
summary: When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore.

name: Ouroboric Pact
summary: You’ve studied pacts at Cobyslarni, or learned under someone who has, and understand them to not only create a bargain between individuals, but a separate entity altogether: the pact itself.

name: Out of Hand
summary: Even when your limbs are severed, they remain a part of you.

name: Overdrive Ally
summary: You quickly fling some of your powered-up mechanisms to an ally, sharing your benefits with them briefly.

name: Pack Movement
summary: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy.

name: Pact of Infernal Prowess
summary: You've sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife.

name: Palatine Strike
summary: Your strikes are particularly deadly against supernatural creatures.

name: Paralyzing Slash
summary: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds.

name: Patron's Breadth
summary: You can cast more spells each day.

name: Peer Beyond
summary: You have uncanny insight into the way ghosts and haunts manifest, manipulate the mind, and rejuvenate.

name: Perfect Resistance
summary: You gain resistance equal to half your level to all damage from effects with the appropriate trait for your School of Perfection: fire for Unblinking Flame, water for Unbreaking Waves, air for Unfolding Wind, and earth for Untwisting Iron.

name: Perpetual Breadth
summary: You have expanded your supply of near-infinite items.

name: Persistent Creation
summary: You can cast _creation_ as an innate spell at will, choosing whether it is arcane or primal each time.

name: Phalanx Formation (Knight Vigilant)
summary: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

name: Physical Training
prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics
summary: You spend a lot of time focusing on your physical fitness.

name: Piercing Doom
summary: You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise.

name: Pinning Fire
summary: You target your opponent's clothing, equipment, or loose flesh with a series of piercing projectiles to pin them to the ground or a nearby surface.

name: Pinpoint Poisoner
summary: Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons.

name: Pluck From the Sky
summary: The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them.

name: Positioning Assault
summary: With punishing blows, you force your opponent into position.

name: Positive Luminance
summary: You learn how to create a luminous reservoir of positive energy that you can use to punish undead who dare attack you.

name: Powerful Snares
summary: Your snares are particularly dif cult for enemies to avoid.

name: Practiced Guidance
summary: You can better Aid your crop.

name: Precious Ammunition
summary: You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material.

name: Predictive Purchase (Rogue)
summary: You somehow manage to have just the thing for the situation.

name: Preventative Treatment
summary: You provide preventative remedies and care to help your patient fight off future maladies.

name: Primal Breadth
summary: Increase the spell slots you gain from druid archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest druid spell slots.

name: Primal Guardian
summary: You grow in power as a guardian of nature.

name: Projectile Snatching
summary: You pluck missiles from the air and hurl them back at their source.

name: Prolific Prophet Spellcasting
summary: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and the number of spell slots you gain from prophet of Kalistrade archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest prophet of Kalistrade spell slots.

name: Protect Ally
summary: You place your body between your friends and your enemies, protecting your allies against oncoming attacks.

name: Protective Pose
summary: Many physical poses can fortify one’s health, but some poses need more than one body to accomplish.

name: Public Execution
summary: Some rebel Firebrand cells make a practice of publicly declaring the main target of a given operation.

name: Purify Element
summary: You turn an element into its purest form.

name: Pushing Wind
summary: As you spin and glide your fans alongside your allies, you kick up a mild wind that gently carries you all forward.

name: Quick Positioning
summary: You're always ready to get the jump on your target.

name: Quick Shield Block
summary: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.

name: Quick Stow (Swordmaster)
summary: You know that situations can change rapidly and might leave you needing to change equipment in the middle of combat.

name: Raise Island
prerequisite: born of the bones of the earth or restless as the tides
summary: You churn the sea and fish up stone so your enemies together can receive their punishment.

name: Raise Menhir
summary: You raise a druidic monument, such as a standing stone or warding tree, from the ground, creating a powerful primal ward that blocks other types of magic.

name: Rally Support
prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; trained in either Diplomacy or Intimidation
summary: You often rely on the local populace for supplies and shelter.

name: Rallying Banner
trait: Brandish, Commander, Emotion, Healing, Mental, Visual
summary: Your banner waves high, reminding your allies that the fight can still be won.

name: Reactive Resilience
summary: Your power blunts blades and weakens spells like the hardiest of dragon scales.

name: Read Disaster
summary: You spend 10 minutes and open yourself to the divine mysteries of the world, peering into the most sinister portents of the future.

name: Reading the Signs
summary: You have a knack for drawing the right card, be it from a harrow deck, in a game of cards, or even when drawing from a _Deck of Many Things_.

name: Recognize Threat
prerequisite: master in a Recall Knowledge skill; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You quickly assess the threat so you can relay the information to your team.

name: Recoiling Relocation
summary: Your innovation contains a chamber to store a small amount of compressed exhaust gas from your Launches.

name: Recycled Cogwheel
summary: You're able to scavenge the cogwheels from your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

name: Reflexive Courage
summary: You bellow a ferocious call to arms, inspiring yourself to lash out at a foe.

name: Reflexive Grip
summary: You keep hold of your weapons even when knocked out.

name: Rejoice in Solstice Storm
prerequisite: whose cry is thunder or dancer in the seasons
summary: You hold your arms out, and the fury of the seasons comes to your jubilant embrace.

name: Reminder of the Greater Fear
summary: You give a target a stern glower to remind them that it is you, and no one else, they should truly fear.

name: Remove Presence
summary: Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it.

name: Rend Armor
summary: Your enemies' defenses are no match for you as you wrench your weapon to compromise their armor.

name: Renewed Vigor
summary: Through the haze of battle, you quickly recover your raging vigor.

name: Repositioning Block
summary: As you absorb a blow from an enemy, you can use their attack's momentum against them.

name: Resounding Bravery
summary: Even your fears serve as fuel for your fighting spirit.

name: Restorative Channel
summary: You can remove conditions with divine grace.

name: Retaliatory Cleansing
summary: You twist your hand in front of the blow, ensuring the enemy's attack shatters the required _holy water_ or bomb.

name: Retch Rust
summary: You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal.

name: Reversing Charge
summary: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed.

name: Ricochet Stance (Rogue)
summary: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

name: Rippling Spin
summary: After the triggering attack is done, Step

name: Rivethun Devotion
summary: Through study, dedication, and introspection, you’ve learned to wield magic that affects the spirit.

name: Rule of Three
summary: Heroes learn from their previous failures, often succeeding on the third attempt.

name: Runic Impression
summary: You can temporarily replicate the effects of a property rune for your weapon or unarmed attacks.

name: Running Tackle
summary: You charge, throwing your body at your foe in a vicious tackle.

name: Rupture Stomp
summary: Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path.

name: Sacrifice Armor
summary: With divine awareness, you twist your body to lessen the impact of an attack.

name: Safeguard Soul
summary: You've girded your soul against outside interference.

name: Sanctify Armament
summary: You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity.

name: Sanguivolent Roots
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Plant, Primal, Wood
summary: Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet.

name: Scarecrow
summary: You fight fiercely to protect your crop.

name: Scattered Fire
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify its area to be two non-overlapping 10-foot bursts.

name: Scattering in Spring
summary: You evade an incoming attack by twisting your enemy’s tactics in your favor.

name: Scholar's Hunch
summary: Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet.

name: Second Blessing
summary: Your continued service grants you another boon.

name: Selfless Parry
summary: You protect those near to you with a flash of steel and a stroke of good luck.

name: Sense Chaos
summary: You sense chaos as an unsettling feeling of nervous energy.

name: Sense Holiness
summary: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness.

name: Sense Unholiness
summary: You sense the truly wicked as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

name: Shadow Spell
summary: You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief.

name: Shadowdancer Dedication
prerequisite: Master in Stealth; Expert in Performance
summary: You dedicate yourself to the shadows.

name: Shamble
summary: You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering.

name: Shambling March
summary: Your horde is swifter, marching in time to your command.

name: Share Rage
summary: You stoke an ally's fury.

name: Sheltering Pulse
summary: You thrust your hand or weapon into the ground and release a pulse that creates a sheltering nexus of energy for you and your allies.

name: Shield from Arrows
summary: You place your shield in the path of an oncoming projectile.

name: Shield Wallop
summary: Attacks with your shield knock the sense out of your foes.

name: Shielding Formation
summary: You have mastered unique magical techniques designed to protect your allies from harm.

name: Shoving Sweep
summary: You swing your weapon at your foe, rebuffing them back.

name: Show-Off
summary: As is the tradition with many Firebrands, you call your shot and look to impress with an extra bit of panache or a greater stunt.

name: Sickening Bite
summary: Your saliva causes severe nausea and mild fever in the living, weakening them so that you can more easily finish them off.

name: Sidestep
summary: You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue.

name: Silence the Profane (Avenger)
summary: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have now mastered and adapted.

name: Silence the Profane (Vindicator)
summary: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy spellcasters from using their prayers against you.

name: Sin Reservoir
summary: During your daily preparations, you can indulge in your associated sin or meditate on its values (and risks).

name: Siphoning Touch
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_
summary: When you cast _vampiric touch_, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the temporary Hit Points yourself, you can grant the temporary Hit Points to an ally within 30 feet.

name: Skill Mastery
prerequisite: Investigator Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill
summary: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.

name: Skill Mastery (Rogue)
prerequisite: Rogue Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill
summary: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.

name: Skim Scroll
summary: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt.

name: Skyseeker
summary: You Leap toward an opponent.

name: Slayer's Blessing
summary: You carry scraps of materials dangerous to undead and can apply them to your weapon.

name: Slurp Up
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tongue
summary: Your tongue darts out in search of refreshment.

name: Sly Striker
summary: Your attacks deal more damage, even against creatures that aren’t off-guard.

name: Smoke Curtain
summary: You load an extra dose of powder into your shot, causing it to belch a cloud of smoke.

name: Smoldering Explosion
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify the spell to leave behind a brief cloud of smoke in its area.

name: Snakebird's Shadow
summary: Ganhil developed this technique through observing the sharp-beaked darters fishing Prada Hanam’s waters, seeking to match their speed and suppleness with the elemental flash of his blade.

name: Snap Out of It! (Pathfinder Agent)
prerequisite: Master in Medicine; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: Pathfinders are trained to help each other be safe and successful, and you know how to jolt your allies back to their senses.

name: Soaring Shape
summary: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below.

name: Solar Detonation
trait: Fire, Impulse, Incapacitation, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Vitality
summary: Blinding flames explode in a swirling sphere! The detonation fills a 20-foot burst within 60 feet of you.

name: Songbird's Call
summary: You call to the wilds with the voice of a songbird, thereby summoning a cloud of its kin.

name: Soul Well
summary: Your brush your fingers across your _splinter of finality_, momentarily creating a metaphysical vortex from which mortal spirits struggle to escape.

name: Soulsight
summary: Your muse has opened your senses to the world beyond.

name: Spell Swipe
summary: You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit.

name: Spelldrinker
summary: You temporarily add a 3rd-rank spell to your spell repertoire, as determined by the type of creature whose blood you just drank.

name: Spellshield
summary: Your shield becomes a bonded item capable of storing your spells.

name: Spike Skin
summary: You touch a willing creature, causing its skin to harden and form spiky protrusions.

name: Spirit Familiar (Witch)
summary: Your familiar can subsume its body to become pure spirit.

name: Spirit Walk
summary: Your allied apparitions ward you against the predations of their restless peers.

name: Spirit's Anguish
summary: You purify a spirit by coaxing it to release its anguish in a final cathartic howl.

name: Sportlebore Choke
summary: Like nefarious sportlebores, a species of insect that plague adventurers by hiding in their rations as counterfeit food, your swarm can crawl down throats.

name: Stab and Blast
summary: You slice or smash your opponent with the melee portion of your weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range.

name: Stalwart Chant
summary: You know story after story of unyielding, valiant dwarven heroes whose minds were bulwarks against fear and confusion.

name: Stalwart Mind
summary: When necessary to avoid a magical compulsion or curse, you can be as stubborn as your megafauna companion.

name: Standby Spell
summary: You've honed one spell as your favored combat technique, and you've practiced it enough that you no longer need to prepare it to cast it.

name: Stasian Charge
summary: Charging a living body with electricity may seem like a bad idea, but you know better.

name: Stasian Smash
summary: You've modified your dynamo with Stasian coils, allowing you to make a powerful attack that crackles with electricity.

name: Statement Strut
summary: You have an eye for fashion and know how to sell attitude and confidence with your walk.

name: Statue
summary: Your body and equipment appear to be made of stone as you hold perfectly still.

name: Steal Vitality
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_
summary: When you cast _vampiric touch_, you can modify it to remove your enfeebled or clumsy condition.

name: Sticky Bomb
summary: You can mix in a sticky additive to an alchemical bomb to make its contents adhere and continue to deal damage.

name: Stitched Familiar
summary: Your familiar can shed its material form, becoming a mass of animated magic.

name: Storm Shroud
summary: You become surrounded by a swirling storm of rain, sand, snow, or clouds, whichever of those suits your bound terrain.

name: Storm Spiral
trait: Air, Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Sonic
summary: Dark thunderclouds swirl in a miniature storm, crisscrossed with lightning bolts; a tremendous thunderclap fills the air.

name: Strangle
summary: You squeeze the breath out of your foe.

name: Stunning Finisher
summary: You attempt a dizzying blow.

name: Submission Hold
summary: Your iron grip saps your opponent’s strength.

name: Subtle Shank
summary: You draw a concealed weapon, attack with it, and then hide it away again in one smooth motion.

name: Sudden Leap
summary: You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar.

name: Superimpose Time Duplicates
summary: You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat.

name: Supreme Psychic Center
summary: With the merest thought, you realign your mental defenses to your duel's circumstances.

name: Surging Focus
summary: When an ally you can see falls in battle, your surge of righteous indignation allows you to draw upon untapped reserves of divine power.

name: Surging Might
summary: You focus the power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances.

name: Surreptitious Spellcaster
summary: You’ve learned that it pays for a Pathfinder to be able to cast spells without being noticed.

name: Survivor of Desolation
summary: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against unnatural weather events or environmental hazards occurring in blighted or otherwise unnaturally marred regions.

name: Swap Reflections
summary: You've learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage.

name: Swashbuckler's Speed
summary: You move with a swashbuckler’s speed and grace.

name: Swim Through Earth
summary: The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it.

name: Swipe Souvenir
summary: When you wriggle free from an enemy’s grasp, you take something of theirs with you.

name: Syu Tak-Nwa's Hexed Locks
summary: Your hair attacks gain the reach trait and you can deliver hexes through it.

name: Tactical Entry
summary: You Stride.

name: Tail Guard
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tail
summary: Enemies who attempt to stab you in the back will be unhappy to find your lashing tail on guard.

name: Tangled Forest Stance
summary: You extend your arms like gnarled branches to interfere with your foes' movements.

name: Tear Tendons
summary: You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength.

name: Terrain Master
summary: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain.

name: Terrifying Transformation
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
summary: Your flesh tears and warps as you transform.

name: The Harder They Fall (Ranger)
summary: You know how to make a larger creature hurt when it falls to the ground.

name: Thoughtsense
summary: You can detect the flickers of mental activity let off by all thinking creatures.

name: Thrash
summary: You thrash your foe around.

name: Tight Follower
summary: You keep up as a protector.

name: To Battle!
summary: With a resounding cry, you rally your ally to take the offensive.

name: Topple Giants
summary: When you observe an ally try and fail to execute a strategic maneuver against your enemies, you coordinate with your other allies to finish the job.

name: Transcribe Moment
summary: You gain the _transcribe moment_ focus spell.

name: Transfusion
summary: You bring forth the regenerative properties of blood on behalf of an ally or yourself.

name: Tumbling Strike
summary: You deftly dive through a gap left by a foe to deliver an advantageous blow.

name: Twirling Strike
summary: Your fans, one raised up alongside your head and the other alongside your hip, become a blur as you twirl across the battlefield.

name: Ubiquitous Gadgets
summary: They thought you had used up all your devices, but they thought wrong! You have a few more gadgets up your sleeve than others expect.

name: Unbelievable Luck
summary: While no one, not even you, might appear to understand why, you demonstrate a greater ability to hit your targets regardless of the obstacles in your way.

name: Unfazed Assessment
prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; expert in Perception
summary: You have witnessed hundreds of fighting styles and quickly adapt to defend against complicated maneuvers.

name: Unkillable
summary: You're relentless and nigh unkillable, shrugging off blows that should destroy you, though they might make your body start to fall apart.

name: Unravel Mysteries
prerequisite: master in a Decipher Writing skill; Scrollmaster Dedication
summary: You can understand the true meaning of texts quickly, and even when you get lost or hit a dead end, you aren’t discouraged from making further attempts to get to the bottom of things.

name: Unrivaled Analysis
summary: Your experience allows you to derive even more information about your opponents from a mere glance.

name: Unseen Passage
summary: You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen.

name: Unshakable Idealism
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in Will saves
summary: Your faith and hope can’t be shaken, and you won’t flee when lives are at stake.

name: Unshaken in Iron
summary: You know the precise limits of your armor, and trust it to save you from harm.

name: Vantage Shot
summary: You and your spotter take advantage of each other's attacks to momentarily hide and throw your foes off-balance against your follow-up attack.

name: Venomous Weapons
summary: Your skill with poisons is such that your preferred weapons also contain trace amounts of it, even when you don't actively  apply a dose.

name: Veteran Follower
summary: Your followers' training has made them veterans of battle.

name: Vicious Fangs
summary: You aim for your victim's prominent arteries.

name: Viking Vindicator
summary: You are one of the raiders eagerly planning to launch an assault by sea on the Whispering Tyrant's Isle of Terror.

name: Vivacious Bravado
summary: Your ego swells, granting you a temporary reprieve from your pain.

name: Void Siphon
summary: The raw energy of the Void saps the essence of the living.

name: Wake to Strife
summary: You summon the explosive power of a geyser beneath a foe.

name: Waking Dream
summary: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others.

name: Walk the Plank
summary: You frighten  a foe into moving where you want them, traditionally demanding they walk the plank.

name: Wall Run
summary: You defy gravity, traversing vertical planes as easily as the ground.

name: Warden's Boon
summary: You point out vulnerabilities present in your hunted prey, granting the benefits listed in Hunt Prey and your hunter’s edge to an ally until the end of their next turn.

name: Warped Constriction
prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is an aberration or outer entity
summary: The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness.

name: Watcher on the Wall
summary: You claim a patron’s symbol that you can etch onto any surface.

name: Water Walker
summary: When in the throes of your curse, your steps take on a supernatural buoyancy.

name: Wayfinder Resonance Infiltrator
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
summary: You are adept at using the unusual resonance of your _wayfinder_ to aid in any deceptions you might employ.

name: What Could Have Been
summary: Rather than conjuring creatures from elsewhere in the world or the planes, you can temporarily pull a much different version of yourself from an alternate timeline.

name: Whirlpool's Pull
summary: You briefly conjure a tendril of water that allows you to grab an improvised weapon and then subsume that water to power your magic.

name: Whispering Steps
summary: Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature—one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that.

name: Whodunnit?
summary: You carefully consider your case and narrow down some of the details.

name: Wild Winds Initiate
summary: You learn a stance that lets you attack from a distance.

name: Wind Caller
summary: You bid the winds to aid you, carrying you through the air and allowing you passage through the strongest headwinds.

name: Wind Seeker
summary: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below.

name: Wing Shove
summary: You spread your wings wide, pushing foes away from you.

name: Witch’s Bottle
summary: You spend 10 minutes and 1 Focus Point brewing a special potion containing the power of one of your hexes that targets a creature.

name: Work Yourself Up
summary: You concentrate on your mental state, tapping into that raw emotional energy.

name: World-Wise Vigilance
summary: Your keen study of other cultures gives you insights into the ways those cultures fight.

name: Worm Empathy
summary: You can connect with cave worms (and other worm-related creatures, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.

name: Wrath of the Hold
summary: Your tattoos carry the strength of an innumerable horde, and you can expend one use of your storied skin’s Living History ability to animate your tattoos as ghostly assailants that swarm your foes.

name: You Don't Smell Right
summary: You can sniff out fellow werecreatures and master impersonators alike.

name: Zealous Rush
summary: You bless yourself on the move.

name: Abjure the False Kin
summary: Your vow reminds you that there can be brackish vinegar hiding within honeyed words, helping you detect attempts to influence your mind.

name: Aboleth Transmutation
summary: You have tapped into the ancient magic used by alghollthu masters to mold the flesh of your ancestors.

name: Absorb Toxin
prerequisite: You are not immune to diseases or poisons
summary: Your skin readily absorbs poison and can consciously draw toxins into your body to spare others.

name: Accursed Claws
summary: Your claws carry your mother’s hag magic.

name: Agathion Magic
summary: The harmonious magic of Nirvana flows through you.

name: Aggravating Scratch
summary: Your claws carry an irritant that is harmless to you but can be damaging to others.

name: Alluring Performance
summary: You command the attention of those around you with an elegant display.

name: Ambush Hunter
summary: You are always searching for the perfect opportunity to ambush your enemies.

name: Analyze Information
summary: You can stoke your mind into a burst of analytical prowess.

name: Anarchic Arcana
summary: The magic in your blood is unpredictable.

name: Ancestral Form
prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage
summary: Casting your memory back deep into the past, you take the form of an ancestral guardian.

name: Ancestral Healer
summary: Following the traditions of those who came before you, you’ve learned how to banish effects that cloud the mind, body, and spirit.

name: Ancillary Motes
summary: You can use Crystalline Dust one more time per day.

name: Animal Magic
summary: Your shapeshifting grants you a magical connection to the animal world.

name: Animal Summoner
summary: The connection between you and primal magic deepens.

name: Arcane Camouflage
summary: You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey.

name: Arcane Propulsion
summary: You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time.

name: Arcane Slam
summary: You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground.

name: Asura Magic
summary: You can cast _blood vendetta_ and _death knell_ once per day each as 2nd-level divine innate spells.

name: Azarketi Purification
summary: You can cast _purify food and drink_ as a primal innate spell, but only on liquids.

name: Azata Magic
summary: Your lineage traces back to the realm of Elysium, and you can harness its magic using this connection.

name: Bark and Tendril
summary: You wield primal magic.

name: Battleforger
summary: You can sharpen weapons, polish armor, and apply special techniques to temporarily gain better effects from your armaments.

name: Between the Scales
summary: You've learned to take advantage of slips in your foes' defenses.

name: Big Mouth
summary: Instead of storing up to four items of Light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items.

name: Blood Must Have Blood
summary: You tap into a bottomless hunger for carnage.

name: Bloodletting Fangs
summary: You emulate your vampiric parent's techniques for drawing blood from a victim.

name: Bond Companion
summary: You form a close bond with a companion, similar to that of a master and familiar, that lets you gift them with a touch of your inherent magic.

name: Bone Caller
summary: Using a mixture of dinosaur bones and the bones of your ancestors to focus your magic, you animate lizards and dinosaurs to carry messages or serve as mounts.

name: Bone Missile
summary: You can remove your ribs to use them as arrows or bolts.

name: Breath Like Honey
summary: You smell of honey and savory things.

name: Breath Unleashed
summary: You’re able to channel more of your draconic benefactor’s power and focus it into your Kobold Breath, increasing its effectiveness but requiring more time to recover.

name: Briar Battler
summary: When you're in difficult terrain from an environmental feature, you can Take Cover, even if the feature wouldn't ordinarily be large enough for you to Take Cover.

name: Brightness Seeker
summary: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes studying your surroundings in search of omens related to a particular course of action to cast _augury_ as an innate divine spell.

name: Brilliant Vision
summary: You ignore concealment from clouds, dust, fog, mist, smoke, and similarly loose matter.

name: Build the First Walls
summary: The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall.

name: Call of Elysium
summary: The wild wonder of Elysium harmonizes within you, and in dire straits, you can share its benefits with your allies.

name: Cantorian Rejuvenation
summary: The life-giving energy that flows in your blood revitalizes you.

name: Captivating Curiosity
summary: You can snare the attentions of onlookers with your unique appearance.

name: Catrina's Presence
summary: You've adopted the calming presence of catrinas, the festive dead..

name: Cautious Curiosity
prerequisite: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat
summary: You've learned a few magical techniques for getting yourself both into and out of trouble unnoticed.

name: Cave Climber
summary: After years of clambering through caverns, you can climb easily anywhere you go.

name: Celestial Magic
prerequisite: Angelkin, Lawbringer, Musetouched, or another lineage feat associated with celestials
summary: You possess celestial magic.

name: Ceremony of Aeon's Guidance
summary: Your patron aeon has allowed you to call upon their gifts to serve their ends.

name: Ceremony of Aeon's Shield
summary: Your patron aeon graced you with powers of protection.

name: Ceremony of Fortification
summary: Your exoskeleton arranges itself into an optimal defensive shape.

name: Ceremony of the Strengthened Hand
summary: Your exoskeleton's weapons are even more potent.

name: Charred Remains
summary: Your next fire spell leaves embers in its wake.

name: Cling
summary: You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission.

name: Close Quarters
summary: If you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small or smaller ally.

name: Coating of Slime
summary: An acidic ooze coats your limbs.

name: Constant Gaze
summary: Your eyes keep a continual watch for dangers from all sides.

name: Consume Magic
summary: You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion.

name: Cooperative Soul
summary: You have developed a soul-deep bond with your comrades and maintain an even greater degree of cooperation with them.

name: Coral Detoxification
summary: The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration.

name: Core Attunement
summary: Your core allows you to draw more power from it.

name: Cunning Climber
summary: Whether you are climbing a ship’s rigging, a jungle tree, or a clock tower, you have an uncanny knack for finding footholds and handholds where larger creatures can’t.

name: Dance of the Tiger
summary: Tales tell of the Tiger stalking the Mousedeer for days, hidden and instilling dread upon its prey.

name: Dance Underfoot
summary: You dart under the legs of your enemies in combat.

name: Dangle
summary: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

name: Dangle (Vanara)
summary: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

name: Death's Drums
summary: Your life has been spent challenging death itself, and proximity to that implacable foe only makes your heart beat harder.

name: Defensive Instincts
summary: Your body tenses up when surrounded, putting you on edge just enough to anticipate an attack.

name: Demolitionist
summary: You know how to destroy objects with a well-placed explosion.

name: Demon Hunter
prerequisite: Expert in Religion or Expert in Demon Lore
summary: The demons of Tanglebriar have long haunted your dreams, just as they have long threatened Kyonin.

name: Dig Up Secrets
summary: You are an endless well of knowledge and can remember several vital pieces of information at once.

name: Disorienting Venom
summary: The venom injected by your fangs disorients your foes.

name: Dissolution's Sight
summary: Accepting your inner darkness means that no outer darkness can obscure your sight.

name: Divine Countermeasures
summary: You’ve studied your extraplanar heritage with the intent of better defending yourself, whether against creatures aligned with or opposed to your extraplanar lineage, and you’ve found that your techniques are equally powerful against celestials, fiends, and other divine entities.

name: Divine Wings
summary: With effort, you can call forth magical wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your extraplanar forebear, whether they be elegantly feathered wings or ominous bat wings.

name: Djinni Magic
summary: The magic of djinn runs through your blood.

name: Dracomancer
summary: The power infused into you by your draconic benefactor’s presence allows you to manifest their most iconic spells.

name: Draconic Paragon
summary: Your connection to your draconic benefactor becomes especially pronounced.

name: Dragon Grip
summary: Your hold has a unique draconic connection.

name: Dragon Prince
summary: The blood of the Dragon Kings runs strong in your veins.

name: Drain Emotion
summary: You touch an adjacent creature and attempt to draw out its excess emotion.

name: Duskwalker Magic
summary: Your connection to psychopomps gives you the power to glimpse the near future and protect corpses from the ravages of undeath.

name: Earthsense
summary: Your connection to earth and stone allows you to feel the slightest displacement that disturbs them, down to the shift of a pebble.

name: Echoes in Stone
summary: You pause a moment to attune your senses to the stone around you.

name: Eerie Compression
summary: Your limbs and even your torso can collapse in on themselves, allowing you to fit through tight spaces as though you were a Small creature.

name: Efreeti Magic
summary: The magic of your efreeti ancestors flows through you.

name: Elf Step
summary: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad.

name: Embodied Dragoon Subjectivity
summary: When your allies call for swift reinforcements or lightning raids, you're ready to answer.

name: Emissary Assistance
summary: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements.

name: Endless Memories
summary: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things.

name: Energize Bite
prerequisite: Breath of the Dragon; jaws unarmed attack
summary: The deadly energy of your breath remains in your jaws to empower your attacks.

name: Energy Blessed
summary: Energy runs through your blood more powerfully.

name: Envenom Strike
prerequisite: you possess a Strike from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat that deals poison damage
summary: You spit venom onto a weapon you're holding or a weapon held by a willing creature within 30 feet; you can also use this ability to envenom your nagaji fangs unarmed attack.

name: Evade Doom
summary: You can elude supernatural disaster.

name: Evolved Spellhorn
summary: Your inborn arcane power grows.

name: Expert Longevity
summary: You've continued to refine the knowledge and skills you've gained through your life.

name: Extraplanar Cloud
summary: When you use Extraplanar Haze, you can spend 1 additional action to disperse the particles as a 10-foot-radius cloud centered on you instead of as a haze; the activity gains the concentrate trait.

name: Fade Away
summary: Your ability to blend into the background allows you to fade away entirely or appear innocuous even to magical effects.

name: Fell Rider
summary: You have trained with your animal companion to become a terrifying juggernaut on the battlefield.

name: Ferocious Gust
summary: With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents.

name: Ferocious Will
summary: You send a blast of magical feedback at the effect's source, dealing 5d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

name: Fey Ascension
summary: The fey influence on your form and features grows even more powerful and notable.

name: Fey Magic
summary: You can use faerie magic to hide yourself and expose hidden foes.

name: Fiend-trampling Stature
summary: Fiends unfortunate enough to be trampled beneath your feet or rent within your grasp are swiftly granulated into bone kindling and blood powder, and the pain of your strikes prevents them from action.

name: Fiendish Magic
prerequisite: Grimspawn, Pitborn, or Hellspawn, or another lineage feat associated with fiends
summary: You possess fiendish magic.

name: Fierce Competitor
summary: You challenge a single ally to a physical competition.

name: First World Adept
prerequisite: at least one primal innate spell
summary: Over time your fey magic has grown stronger.

name: Fleeing Shriek
summary: You let out an ear-piercing screech.

name: Flower Magic
summary: Certain magics in the world flow easily through your sap.

name: Flowering Path
summary: Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life.

name: Forever Among Humanity
summary: Passing unseen within society is second nature to you now.

name: Formidable Breath
summary: Thanks to rigorous breathing exercises and a diet similar to that of your lineage, your magical breath is more powerful.

name: Fortified Mind
summary: Your mind is unusually resilient and resistant to influence.

name: Fortuitous Shift
summary: You have grown more comfortable with your penchant for supernatural disappearance.

name: Four-armed Aspect
summary: You intone vows to shoulder others’ pains; in response, your torso sprouts an additional pair of arms to help you bear those burdens.

name: Fox Arson
summary: When you critically hit with a foxfire Strike, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent damage of the same type as the foxfire.

name: Fox Trick
summary: You always have time for a joke or prank.

name: Freeze It!
summary: You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you.

name: Friendly Fling
summary: You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield.

name: Full Flight
summary: Your flight is unbound, as natural as it was before you were awakened.

name: Fully Flighted
summary: You gain the effects of Juvenile Flight at all times, rather than just once per day for 10 minutes.

name: Garuda Magic
summary: You are descended from the wondrous garudas, and their keen senses manifest in your magical prowess.

name: Glory and Valor!
summary: You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first.

name: Goblin Club
summary: You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you.

name: Goring Charge
summary: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes.

name: Grand Metamorphosis
summary: One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ.

name: Grandmother's Wisdom
summary: You carry the bones of your ancestors with you, and you can ask them for counsel.

name: Greater Transformation
summary: You can assume your oni form more easily, and with greater benefits.

name: Green Dash
summary: The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed.

name: Gripping Limbs
summary: Nodules, hooks, or claws on your limbs allow you to cling to surfaces with ease.

name: Group Aid
summary: Your upbringing emphasized teamwork, and helping your allies comes naturally to you.

name: Grow Tool
summary: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape.

name: Guarded Thoughts
summary: Your mind, like a dark naga's, foils attempts to read your thoughts.

name: Guiding Luck
summary: Your luck guides you to look the right way and aim your blows unerringly.

name: Hardy Traveler
summary: There’s no journey too far or burden too heavy when you have friends at your side or hope within your heart.

name: Hefting Shadow
summary: Your shadow can contain objects.

name: Heir of the Saoc
summary: In the past, you would have been a proud initiate of the Saoc Brethren.

name: Helpful Halfling
summary: When you aid a friend with a task, you find many ways to help and avoid interfering.

name: Herbal Forager
summary: Your skill with herbs has improved.

name: Hero's Wings
summary: You have begun the final steps to reaching your full potential.

name: Heroes' Call
summary: The songs of ancient heroes echo through your mind and quicken your pulse, especially in dire straits.

name: Home in the Deep
summary: You cut through the water, and dwell beneath the surface with ease.

name: Hone Claws
summary: You grind or gnaw a particularly wicked edge onto your claws.

name: Horn and Bone Incantation
summary: You invoke mantras of tellurian rebirth.

name: Hungry Goblin
summary: You’ll eat anything and anyone.

name: Hypnotic Gaze
summary: You can widen your field of vision, allowing you to affect more creatures with your Hypnotic Lure.

name: I Will Return
summary: Your special connection to death and rebirth allows you to sense when it’s your time to enter the Great Beyond, and now isn’t the time.

name: Iivlar's Deflection
summary: You’re able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows.

name: Ill Tide
summary: Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck.

name: Improvisational Warrior
summary: You have increased skill with improvised weapons.

name: Incredible Improvisation
summary: A stroke of brilliance gives you a major advantage with a skill despite your inexperience.

name: Inner Breath
summary: Your body is capable of recycling its own air.

name: Internal Respirator
summary: Your body can internally synthesize oxygen for limited periods of time.

name: Into the Sky
summary: You fly as naturally as any dragonet.

name: Invoke the Elements
prerequisite: Brine May, Snow May, Veil May, or Virga May
summary: You summon an aura of shimmering heat, flurrying snow, crashing waves, or swirling wind and lightning.

name: Irrepressible
summary: You are easily able to ward off attempts to play on your fears and emotions.

name: Jalmeri Rakshasa Magic
summary: You can cast _dispel magic_ and _reaper's lantern_ once per day each as 2nd-level divine innate spells.

name: Janni Hospitality
summary: You can use magic to show others desert hospitality.

name: Janni Magic
summary: The magic of jann runs through your blood.

name: Jotun's Boost
summary: Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield.

name: Kizidhar Magic
summary: You can wield the arcane magic of a kizidhar

name: Kneel for No God
summary: Your ancestors’ defiance of magic and your people’s strictly egalitarian mindset mean that certain forms of magic have little effect on you.

name: Kodama Call
summary: The small spirits known as kodama pride themselves in taking care of trees and other vegetation, and they’ll happily come to your aid as well.

name: Larcenous Tail
summary: You can perform minor mischief with your tail.

name: Laughing Kholo
summary: Your sinister giggle is a sound of warning and threat.

name: Legendary Size
summary: The vanaras of old were tricksters able to step across wide rivers or slip into impossibly small spaces.

name: Lesser Augmentation
summary: You've focused on enhancing yourself and have received an improvement to one of your existing abilities.

name: Life Leap
summary: You phase through a space that a living creature occupies in a flash, spontaneously appearing on the opposite side of it in a vibrant display of colorful light.

name: Life's Blood
summary: Your journey to enlightenment has made your blood possess nigh-immortal properties, allowing you to heal others.

name: Lingering Echoes
summary: Not everyone is reincarnated, and you feel a strong connection with the spiritual echoes of those who didn’t receive the same opportunity as you.

name: Luck of the Clowder
summary: When you use Cat's Luck to reroll, any creatures you choose within 10 feet who also just failed against the same effect (such as a single spell) can also reroll their saving throws and use the better result.

name: Lucky Keepsake
summary: You have a keepsake that grants you luck.

name: Many Faces
summary: Putting on a new face offers a great way to get a fresh perspective on life.

name: Many Guises
summary: You can use Shifting Faces three times per day instead of once per day.

name: Marid Magic
summary: You channel the magic of marids.

name: Mask of Pain
summary: Your mask has grown into a manifestation of your pain, which you can release.

name: Memory of Skill
summary: Your years of training in a previous life didn’t go to waste with your death, and you can call upon this training when you most need it.

name: Mentor of Legends
summary: You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity.

name: Methodical Magic
summary: You can reorder the world with your magic.

name: Mineral Deposits
summary: Precious metals from your bloodstream line your claws, jaws, or the tip of your tail, and you’re able call upon your blood to surge and empower your attacks.

name: Miraculous Repair
trait: Arcane, Ardande, Concentrate, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Transmutation, Undine
summary: Geniekin can't grant magical wishes, but some echo of power lingers within you.

name: Mirror Refuge
summary: Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell one with stone.

name: Moderate Enhance Venom
summary: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to moderate vishkanyan venom.

name: Moisture Bath
summary: Your moist skin is especially resistant to damage from temperature-altering effects.

name: Moray Eel Mount
summary: You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild.

name: Morrigna's Spider Affinity
summary: Much like morrignas, you feel an affinity for spiders.

name: Mother's Mindfulness
summary: You have the protective instinct your own mother lacks and will gladly suffer in another's place.

name: Mountain's Stoutness
summary: Your hardiness lets you withstand more punishment than most.

name: Mud Boat's Passage
summary: You instinctively create magical boats that keep your feet dry (mostly).

name: Multitalented
summary: You’ve learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease.

name: Natural Magnetism
summary: Your connection with elemental iron grants you a natural field of weak magnetic attraction.

name: Night Magic
summary: You can tap into the magic that runs through your blood.

name: No Evidence
summary: You leave little sign when attempting to remain unseen.

name: Nodal Healing
summary: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body.

name: Occult Resistance
summary: Your study of occult practices has shown you how to best defend against them.

name: Offensive Subroutine
summary: Nanites augment your attacks.

name: Otherworldly Acumen
prerequisite: at least one innate spell gained from an elf ancestry feat
summary: The arcane magic you possess grows in power and complexity.

name: Overcrowd
summary: As long as you are Small, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small ally.

name: Pack Tactics
summary: You have mastered how to hunt with your pack.

name: Paralyzing Jewel
summary: Your dedication to the ideals of art and beauty allows your head gem to access the power of the waning moon.

name: Perfume Cloud
summary: You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water.

name: Peri Magic
summary: The shimmering embers of the righteous peris crackle at your fingertips.

name: Persistent Odor
summary: Your pheromones now linger on creatures.

name: Pervasive Superstition
summary: You steep yourself in superstition and practice ancient orc mental exercises for shrugging off the effects of magic.

name: Phantom Orchestra
summary: An easy way to trick others is to throw your voice into a nearby forest or thicket to make strange noises.

name: Piercing Quills
summary: Your quills can dig particularly deep into the flesh of your opponents.

name: Pinch Time
summary: One of your parents has a human life span and another an elven life span, with your own somewhere between.

name: Plane Step
summary: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you concealment until the end of your next turn.

name: Plant Soul Siblings
summary: You’re now able to connect with the spirits present in the greenery of the natural world.

name: Political Virtuoso
summary: Your mastery of the politics of your home nation is profound.

name: Pollinate
summary: As you’re hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight.

name: Predator's Growl
summary: You give a throaty growl to attempt to Demoralize a creature you just found.

name: Preemptive Reconfiguration
summary: Your body anticipates the blow.

name: Pride in Arms
summary: With a shout of triumph, you grant inspiration to an ally fight on.

name: Qlippoth Magic
summary: You've deeply studied the secrets of your blood and can force reality to act against its own wishes.

name: Quick Recovery (Yaoguai)
summary: You use your command over your form to repair lifethreatening wounds.

name: Quietus Strikes
summary: Your connection to the Boneyard empowers you to bring death to all forms of life and unlife, exploiting their weaknesses.

name: Quill Spray
prerequisite: Quillcoat Shisk heritage or quill unarmed attack
summary: You can launch a mass of quills at opponents.

name: Ragdya's Dance
summary: Even when faced with deadly danger, you fight with the rapturous laughter of Ragdya in your heart and can play impossible tricks.

name: Rain of Bolts
summary: Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis.

name: Rakshasa Magic
summary: You remember the secrets of your rakshasa forebears and know how to apply those memories to get results.

name: Rakshasa Ravaged
summary: You and your family know well the ravages of rakshasa predations, and you know how to best defend yourself against their growing corruption in the world.

name: Rapid Retraining
summary: Some feel trapped by their choices and have a tough time reinventing themselves.

name: Rat Form
summary: You can transform into an innocuous-looking rat.

name: Read the Stars
prerequisite: Trained in Astrology Lore or Trained in Occultism
summary: You're incredibly skilled in iruxi astrology, and you can gain useful (if cryptic) hints from the stars' alignment.

name: Rejuvenation Token
summary: You tie yourself to the Material Plane by implanting a piece of your consciousness into a weapon, piece of armor, or other item that's precious to you.

name: Repair Module
summary: You trigger your body's repair programming, causing your body's nanites to heal your wounds.

name: Replenishing Hydration
summary: You draw life from the water around you.

name: Returning Throw
summary: You have mastered the technique of arcing a projectile so that it returns to your hand after being thrown, though this requires a moment to precisely calculate the trajectory and possible ricochets.
