name: Ricocheting Leap
summary: You quickly use your momentum to topple and spring off of foes.

name: Ride On
summary: Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance.

name: Riptide
summary: Drag a grabbed creature into nearby water

name: River Adaptation
summary: Webbing sprouts on your legs and tail as you shift to a more aquatic form.

name: Rivethun Spiritual Attunement
summary: Your time spent among the Rivethun has heightened your awareness of animate spirits around you, giving you the ability to sense them briefly.

name: Rokoan Arts
summary: Ancestral spirits have begun to bond themselves to you, granting you powers characteristic of a rokoa.

name: Roll with It (Goblin)
summary: When you take a big hit, your foe bounces you around like a rubber ball, but you escape the worst of the blow.

name: Rolling White Bottle Form
summary: As you fall to the ground, you transform into a white bottle, gourd, or sake jar, then roll away before anyone can pick you up.

name: Rouse the Dreaming Relic
summary: The spirit within your pusaka resonates with other magical items in your possession.

name: Sash of the Wind
summary: At your request, the nature spirits of the air and wind spin themselves into an iridescent sash loosely draped around your shoulders that buoys you through the sky.

name: Scalding Spit
summary: Your bodily fluids burn with surprising volatility, as if you ran on oil instead of blood.

name: Scaling Poppet
summary: Your construction integrates ropes, hooks, or other tools to help you move across steep surfaces.

name: Scarlet Strands
summary: The innate magic in your blood turns your signature crimson tresses into more than just a stylish coiffure.

name: Scorching Disarm
summary: You make a weapon unbearable to hold.

name: Sculpt Shadows
summary: You coax nearby shadows into the shape of a simple weapon or a simple tool or item, using a tiny piece of your shadow to make it solid; in doing so, you lose 1 Hit Point.

name: Secrets of the Past
summary: You’ve established a stronger connection with your past selves and can play out the memories of your lifetimes in an instant, helping you draw on knowledge that lives deep within your mind.

name: Sense for Trouble
summary: You can tell when something's off.

name: Sense Thoughts
summary: You have an even stranger knack for knowing what other people are thinking.

name: Serpentcoil Slam
summary: Your people's ancient and storied rivalry with garudas led you to develop special techniques against flying foes.

name: Serpentine Swimmer
summary: You undulate your body in a series of sinuous serpentine motions as you swim, drastically improving the speed at which you move through the water.

name: Shadow Sight
summary: You draw on your connection with the Shadow Plane to see through all but the deepest darkness.

name: Shadow Tempo
summary: As your ally moves past you, you match your movements to their rhythm, following them across the battlefield.

name: Shaitan Magic
summary: The magic of shaitans runs through your blood.

name: Sheltering Wing
summary: You raise your fledgling wings to protect you from attack, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn.

name: Shore Gift
summary: Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger.

name: Shory Aeromancer
prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity
summary: Your ancestors hailed from the flying cities of the Shory, and a few simple tricks have come down through the ages to you.

name: Silent Step
summary: You Step, then Hide or Sneak.

name: Siphon Torment
summary: Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others.

name: Siren Song
summary: You can beguile and bewitch with your song.

name: Skeletal Resistance
summary: Your body becomes resistant, your hardened bones deflecting weapons and other forms of damage.

name: Skittering Scuttle
summary: You can scuttle farther and faster when maneuvering alongside allies.

name: Slip into Shadow
prerequisite: ability to cast at least one spell with the darkness trait
summary: Your shadow magic bleeds into the space around you.

name: Slip the Grasp
summary: You have some feature that allows you to quickly evade effects that restrain you.

name: Smoke Sight
summary: You're used to fighting and hiding in a haze of smoke and flame.

name: Snare Commando
prerequisite: Snare Crafting; Expert in Deception or Expert in Intimidation
summary: Your snares are so befuddling that your victims rarely notice you slipping out of sight.

name: Soaring Form
summary: You have a fly Speed of 20 feet at all times.

name: Sodbuster
summary: Years toiling in soil have made you an expert digger.

name: Solar Rejuvenation
summary: If you rest outdoors for 10 minutes during the day, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × half your level.

name: Solar Rejuvenation (Ghoran)
summary: The warmth and light of the sun gives you life.

name: Solidarity
summary: You bestow some of your own life energies to mend damage.

name: Speaker's Defense
prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or Speaker in Training
summary: As a Speaker, you've forged a deep bond with powerful spirits who you can urge to rise up to defend you and your people.

name: Spiritual Echo
summary: You possess the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, which has begun to resonate with your own.

name: Spore Cloud
summary: You unleash a cloud of pollen or similar spores.

name: Squad Tactics
summary: You are adept at working with your allies to surround an enemy.

name: Stone Bones
summary: Your intractable nature can help you shrug off even the most grievous injuries.

name: Stone Passage
summary: Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through.

name: Stonewalker
summary: You have a deep reverence for and connection to stone.

name: Strand Strider
summary: Your eight legs serve you well when climbing walls and webs alike.

name: Strong Swimmer
summary: Your swim Speed increases to match your land Speed.

name: Stubborn Defiance
summary: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another.

name: Studious Adept
summary: You achieve a breakthrough in your exploration of magic.

name: Swift Application
summary: You expertly combine the motions of attacking and coating your weapon with venom.

name: Tears of Pearl
trait: Emotion, Manipulate, Mental, Merfolk, Primal, Visual
summary: You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them.

name: Telekinetic Slip
summary: A thin shell of telekinetic energy pushes from your skin, widening your enemy's grasp enough for you to slip free.

name: Terrain Advantage
summary: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain are off-guard to you.

name: Tetraelemental Assault
summary: Your Elemental Assault cycles through all four elements.

name: Thorned Seedpod
summary: When your seedpods strike a felling blow, they burst into viciously thorny vines.

name: Tongue Tether
summary: Your tongue can momentarily latch on as readily as your hands.

name: Towering Growth
summary: You're capable of growing as tall as a pine tree for a short time.

name: Transcendent Realization
summary: You've unleashed even more of your mind's limitless potential.

name: Tree Climber
summary: You've spent much of your life among the treetops and have become an expert at quickly and safely climbing them.

name: True Dragon's Flight
summary: Your wings have grown more powerful, capable of keeping you aloft longer.

name: Two-Truths
summary: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself.

name: Uncanny Cheeks
summary: You gain the Prescient Consumable and Prescient Planner feats, except that you always withdraw the objects from your cheek pouches.

name: Undying Ferocity
summary: You resist death’s clutches with supernatural vigor, daring death to claim you while promising that any such attempt will surely fail.

name: Unhampered Passage
summary: You won't allow others to restrain you.

name: Unleash Yaoguai Might
summary: As you enter your yaoguai form, you draw upon your internal magic to assume an even greater form.

name: Unyielding Disguise
prerequisite: ability to cast _humanoid form_ or _illusory disguise_
summary: When you cast _humanoid form_ or _illusory disguise_ to alter your appearance, the spell's duration is 2 hours

name: Velstrac Magic
summary: You know there's so much more to sensation than whips and chains—but whips and chains also have their place.

name: Viper Strike
summary: You move and attack with a swiftness that most can't follow.

name: Virtue-Forged Tattoos
summary: Your tattoos are a work of eldritch genius, a masterpiece of art, magic, and skin.

name: Vivacious Conduit
summary: Your connection to the First World has grown, and its vital energy flows into you rapidly.

name: Wary Skulker
summary: You can perform the Scout exploration activity at the same time as the Avoid Notice exploration activity.

name: Water Dancer
summary: You glide through the water with graceful ease.

name: Water Strider
summary: Water cradles your every step, allowing you to walk on its surface.

name: Web Hunter
summary: Through the careful cultivation of highly sensitive hairs, you've developed the ability to sense creatures without seeing them.

name: Wheedle and Jig
summary: You make capering motions and silly sounds to captivate onlookers.

name: Whispers in the Night
summary: You weave your illusions with greater ability, allowing you to play tricks and slip through the night.

name: Wind God's Fan
summary: Your fan can stir up even more powerful winds.

name: Wing Buffet
summary: You have a pair of draconic wings strong enough to batter your foes away and shove them away.

name: Wing Step
summary: With a sharp flap of your wings, you stay light on your feet as you move.

name: Winglet Flight
summary: Intense use and exercise have made your winglets more powerful.

name: Wings of Air
summary: You can strain to call forth feathered or cloudy wings from your back.

name: Witness of Earth
summary: The primal magic in your soul offers the patient earth’s timeless counsel.

name: World-protector's Hospitality
summary: Through your spiritual power, you impede starvation and restore pantries.

name: You Seem Somewhat Familiar
summary: You fought hundreds of foes in your various past lives, and now and then, something about a new opponent tugs at your memory, almost as if you defeated their grandparent long ago.

name: Accursed Clay Fist
prerequisite: Golem Grafter Dedication; expert in unarmed attacks
summary: You have replaced one of your forearms with one made of clay and infused with cursed arcane magic.

name: Add Element
summary: Choose a second kinetic element to add to the one you already have.

name: Advanced Domain Spirit
summary: Your connection with your domain spirit has deepened.

name: Advanced Efficient Alchemy
summary: You make an even-larger batch of alchemical items each morning.

name: Aerial Piledriver
summary: Heaving both yourself and your opponent into the air, you bring them crashing to the ground.

name: Agile Grace
summary: Your graceful moves with agile weapons are beyond compare.

name: Ancestral Mage
summary: The magic of your ancestry and bloodline are one and the same.

name: Angel of Death
summary: All your Strikes against a creature you have Marked for Death have the death trait, causing the mark to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

name: Annotate Composition
summary: By putting composition to paper, you can create a source of stirring words or song that others can read and understand.

name: Apparition's Quickening
summary: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, you can draw power from one of your attuned apparitions to reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Armor Rune Shifter
summary: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion.

name: Armored Rest
prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor
summary: You've slept many nights in your armor and gotten used to it.

name: Assured Ritualist
summary: You can cover for a secondary caster's error.

name: Attunement to Stone
summary: You can feel vibrations through the ground.

name: Aura Shaping
summary: You control the size of your kinetic aura.

name: Azure Fins
summary: When submerged in water or another liquid, you form small fin-like arms along your body, granting you far greater maneuverability while swimming.

name: Bat Form
summary: You can transform into a bat.

name: Battle Scars
summary: You've faced enough opponents that your experience is written across your skin, toughening you against your fiendish foes.

name: Battle-Hardened Companion
summary: Accompanying you across countless battlefields has allowed your companion to unleash its full potential.

name: Battlefront Sabotage
summary: You know methods of sabotaging your enemy's war machines and weaponry.

name: Bear Empathy
summary: You have a magical affinity for bears and can speak to them through sounds and body language.

name: Beast Dynamo Howl
summary: You've incorporated beast tech from Arcadia into your dynamo, adding in components from various terrifying creatures to enhance your prosthesis's capabilities.

name: Beastmaster Bond
summary: You can communicate telepathically with your animal companions within 100 feet.

name: Belly Flop
summary: You crush an enemy under the enormous weight of your armor.

name: Beneath Notice
prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Deception
summary: You are skilled at hiding from your foes and targets among the common populace.

name: Bestiary Scholar
prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Crafting, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Scrollmaster Dedication
summary: You learn how to apply your extensive knowledge of certain creatures using the lore you know.

name: Big Debut
summary: Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it.

name: Black Powder Flash
summary: You ignite a pinch of black powder in a foe's face.

name: Blade of the Heart
summary: The bonds of the heart are stronger than any steel, more powerful than any magic.

name: Blazing Streak
summary: Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement.

name: Borrow Time
summary: You reach ahead and make use of time that's yet to be.

name: Breath of Vital Ash
summary: Reddish ash stains your ikon, impossible to clean off.

name: Buckler Dance
summary: You spin your buckler defensively toward every attack.

name: Bullet Dancer Reload
summary: You've learned to reload your simple firearms with uncanny grace, the ammunition simply falling into place as though part of a well-practiced kata.

name: Burrowing Form
summary: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt.

name: Burrowing Shot
summary: You tune light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces.

name: Call Worm Spirit
summary: You call forth a ghostly manifestation of the worm spirit.

name: Called Shot
summary: You target a specific area of your foe's anatomy to debilitating effect.

name: Camouflage
summary: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

name: Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation
summary: Your Cascade Bearer training allows you to broaden the horizons of your halcyon spells further than most Magaambyans, weaving in spiritual magic.

name: Cascading Ray
summary: Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck.

name: Castigating Weapon
summary: The force of your deity’s castigation strengthens your body so you can strike down the enemy and its allies.

name: Cautious Delver
summary: You've studied the many ways that ancient architects and spellcasters protected their possessions, such as by implementing deadly traps and curses, and learned some magic to counteract them.

name: Certain Strike
summary: Even when you don’t hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow.

name: Chain Infusion
summary: The elemental matter in your blast keeps reconstituting itself to travel onward, no matter how many bodies it collides with.

name: Channel Rot
summary: You've learned to channel your curse through weapons you wield instead of solely through your flesh.

name: Close Contract
summary: You’re bolstered when a plan comes together.

name: Close Formation
prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Master in Performance
summary: You practiced fan dance as a member of a large group, coordinating your moves together to create living art and heightening your sense of spatial awareness.

name: Cloud Walk
summary: Your growing link to cloud dragons has granted you the ability to walk on clouds.

name: Cobra Envenom
prerequisite: Cobra Stance; expert in unarmed strikes
summary: You slightly dislocate your joints to lash out with devious intent and the power to envenom your foe.

name: Come and Get Me
summary: You open yourself to attacks so you can respond in turn.

name: Comforting Presence
trait: Concentrate, Emotion, General, Mental, Skill, Uncommon
summary: Your occult connection to your allies lets you take on fear and confusion they feel.

name: Command Attention
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Aura, Concentrate, Emotion, Mental, Visual
summary: You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn.

name: Communal Tale
summary: Stories are an experience meant to be shared as a group.

name: Consecrate Spell
trait: Cleric, Concentrate, Metamagic, Oracle, Sorcerer, Uncommon
prerequisite: ability to cast focus spells, divine spells
summary: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it.

name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance
summary: You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies.

name: Counterclockwork Focus
summary: You understand the need for law enforcement doctrine to adapt to the ever-changing innovations in technology and arcana.

name: Courageous Assault
summary: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack.

name: Crashing Slam
summary: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

name: Cursebreaker
summary: Using various implements and esoteric methods, you can attempt to remove a curse from an unfortunate victim.

name: Cut from the Air
summary: You can knock aside ranged attacks.

name: Daring Flourish
summary: You make quick use of an opening from your daring stunts.

name: Dazzling Block
prerequisite: Arcane Cascade, sparkling targe hybrid study
summary: When you use Shield Block, you can create a flash of brilliant, multicolored light in a 15-foot cone.

name: Dazzling Display
summary: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

name: Deathguard
summary: The twisting rotted limbs, clattering bones, or swirling ectoplasm of your horde can hide you from others' vision.

name: Debilitating Shot
summary: Aiming for a weak point, you impede your foe with a precise shot.

name: Deepening Devotion
summary: Your investment in your _draconic gift_ has unlocked greater power.

name: Define "Report"
summary: Look, getting caught in a lie is a normal part of venture-gossip life.

name: Deflecting Shot
summary: You're always ready to take a quick shot to deflect a weapon or distract a foe enough to render them off target.

name: Defy Hell
summary: Your devotion to your cause gives you endless strength and courage to withstand the enemy's attacks.

name: Defy Sorrow
summary: You draw on this spiritual pain to push your body to greater heights.

name: Demanding Challenge
summary: If your skill check to challenge a foe is a success, the target of your challenge takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls (or –2 if you critically succeed) until the end of your next turn.

name: Deny Support
summary: Keep opponents from flanking when you Feint them.

name: Deny the Songs of War
summary: To keep the peace, you disrupt those who seek to break it.

name: Derring-do
summary: When you compound panache with even more derring-do, it somehow tends to work out.

name: Destructive Block
summary: You can protect yourself more effectively, at the expense of your shield.

name: Determined Dash
summary: Nothing can keep you from your enemy.

name: Dimensional Disappearance
prerequisite: _dimensional assault_ focus spell, laughing shadow hybrid study
summary: You take advantage of teleportation to better hide your position.

name: Dire Growth
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape is not Small
summary: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape.

name: Disarming Twist
summary: After your initial attack redirects your foe’s defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp.

name: Disperse into Petals
summary: You merge with the blossoms sprouting from you and disperse, becoming a visible cloud of blossoms and petals.

name: Disruptive Stance
summary: The slightest distraction can provoke your wrath, and you’re prepared to foil enemies’ actions.

name: Distant Wandering
summary: Your body falls unconscious and your spirit projects out of it.

name: Distracting Explosion
summary: Your enemies think they can concentrate on something else while you're nearby? Oh, you'll give them a distraction, all right!

name: Dizzying Spin Dance
summary: You’re practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed.

name: Double, Double
summary: For each temporary oil or potion you brew during your daily preparations, you brew two copies of it.

name: Drain Vitality
summary: You draw out the bestial magic energy within your bonded beast gun to fortify yourself, purge ongoing harm, and bolster your life force with a sheath of swirling life essence.

name: Draw from the Land
summary: You pull strength from the surrounding terrain.

name: Dream Guise
summary: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you.

name: Drilled Reflexes
summary: You leave a lasting impression on your squadmates that makes them particularly adept at following your commands.

name: Dual-Weapon Blitz
summary: You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield.

name: Eerie Proclamation
trait: Auditory, Concentrate, Curse, Druid, Linguistic, Manipulate, Primal, Ranger, Uncommon
prerequisite: Expert in Occultism; Expert in Survival
summary: You know there are places in the world that are just wrong— places where the birds don't sing and where you always feel like you're being watched.

name: Eidetic Memorization
summary: Pathfinders are often asked to study the intricacies of ancient history under less than ideal conditions, and you've trained your brain to make the most of your limited time.

name: Eldritch Debilitations
summary: You know how to apply debilitations that are particularly troublesome for spellcasters.

name: Eldritch Reload
summary: You integrate your talent for magic into your use of reloading weapons.

name: Electrify Armor
summary: You electrify your armor to punish foes who dare to attack you.

name: Elemental Shape
summary: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements.

name: Elemental Transformation
summary: You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy.

name: Elucidating Mercy
summary: Your mercy grants clarity to those around you just when they need it most.

name: Emerald Boughs Hideaway
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Emerald Boughs affiliation
summary: You use Emerald Bough techniques to create a small extradimensional space called a hideaway that lasts as long as you are conscious.

name: Emissary of Peace
summary: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender.

name: Emotional Surge
summary: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment.

name: Emphatic Emissary
summary: You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows.

name: Endure Death's Touch
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in medium or heavy armor
summary: Your conviction redirects the undead’s attack through your armor and then harmlessly away.

name: Energy Fusion
summary: You fuse two spells together, combining their energy types.

name: Ensnaring Wrappings
summary: Some of your wrappings come loose to ensnare a creature you recently damaged.

name: Entwined Energy Ki
summary: You can transform your inner power into a type of energy to empower your ki abilities.

name: Everyone Duck!
summary: You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap’s effects.

name: Exemplar Expertise
summary: Your soul has been further tempered in divine power.

name: Expand Spiral
summary: Your prayers encompass your companions, granting you the ability to share Pharasma's blessings.

name: Expanded Splash
summary: You can throw bombs at just the right trajectory to create especially large and powerful explosions.

name: Expert Captivator Spellcasting
summary: You learn more powerful spells to enchant and deceive.

name: Expert Skysage Divination
summary: Your studies of the stars have taught you about the mysteries of the cosmos.

name: Exult in Violence
summary: You let out a war cry as your blow lands true, and judgment descends on an enemy.

name: Fading
summary: You partially fade from reality.

name: Falcon Swoop
summary: Like the fastest of predatory birds, you soar toward your prey at great speeds.

name: Fearsome Brute
summary: Fear makes your foes weak and more vulnerable to your attacks.

name: Feast Planner
summary: You learn the fortifying brew ritual, but you instead prepare dishes for a lavish meal that have the same effect as the drinks from the normal version of the ritual.

name: Feed the Void
trait: Deviant, Extradimensional, Magical, Mental, Rare, Spirit
summary: The void within you manages to manifest itself temporarily, a black hole opening over your heart and threatening to draw everything in.

name: Feral Lunge
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a fangs or jaws unarmed attack
summary: You spring on an unsuspecting opponent, tearing at them with your teeth.

name: Feral Scramble
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a claw unarmed attack
summary: Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed.

name: Feral Toss
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants an antler, horn, or tusk unarmed attack
summary: You hurl foes away with a shake of your head.

name: Ferocious Charge
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an antlers, head, or horn unarmed attack
summary: You've taught your companions to charge directly at an enemy.

name: Fish from the Falls' Edge
summary: Seeing your ally fall, you let out a cry, sending your divine spark to them temporarily to keep them from tumbling down the River of Souls.

name: Flailtongue
summary: Your tongue has mutated into a lashing weapon reminiscent of Kabriri's bone-laden flail.

name: Flash your Badge
prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Intimidation
summary: You make a fearsome show of your authority.

name: Flinging Charge
summary: You throw a weapon to distract your opponent as you close the gap to begin your assault.

name: Fluttering Distraction
summary: You’re trained in snapping and fluttering your fans to draw the eyes of observers around you.

name: Fly on Shadowed Wings
summary: Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings.

name: Font of Knowledge
summary: Experience or focused study have granted you mastery of a number of topics.

name: Form Up!
summary: You’ve trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations.

name: Furious Sprint
summary: You rush forward.

name: Fused Polearm
summary: During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse your arcane bonded weapon and a magical staff together into one item, with the staff making up the haft of the weapon.

name: Gathering Moss
summary: By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster.

name: Gaze of Veracity
prerequisite: Hellknight Signifer Dedication; ability to cast focus spells
summary: You can channel your mask’s power to pierce through lies and see the truth in any situation.

name: Geobukseon Retaliation
summary: Your armor has a retractable spike-covered shell reminiscent of Hwanggot’s heavily armored geobukseon, or “turtle ships.” The shell unfolds across your body, giving you a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 2 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Get Behind Me!
summary: When saving your allies from harm, you push them behind you to better protect them.

name: Ghost-path Epiphany
summary: Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the enmity and fear of more traditional cultivators.

name: Ghostsong
summary: You have come to understand the pain and fury of spirits and can raise them to do your ghastly work.

name: Giant Snare
summary: You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

name: Gift of the Hoard
prerequisite: You have succeeded at an important task given by a dragon, such as procuring a special treasure for their hoard.
summary: In pleasing the cravings of a mighty dragon, they have deigned to impart some of their magical essence into your body.

name: Glass Skin
prerequisite: You were present at the death of the medusa Alethsia, whose vitrumantic powers were passed on to you in the wake of her destruction.
summary: Even if vitrumancy is a mystery to you, your blood and flesh know the secrets of the art of arcane glass.

name: Glutton for Flesh
summary: You have developed a capacity to store more flesh within your gaunt body to leave yourself satiated longer.

name: Goblin Jubilee Display
summary: Flames and explosions sear the air in a riot of color and devastation that rivals that wrought by even the wildest goblin party.

name: Grave Sight
summary: Your ability to sense undead has improved.

name: Great Cleave
summary: Your fury carries your weapon through multiple foes.

name: Greater Awakened Power
summary: Your power undergoes yet another awakening

name: Greater Bloodline
summary: You uncover the greater secrets of your bloodline.

name: Greater Deathly Secrets
summary: Your undead secrets grow stronger still.

name: Greater Debilitating Bomb
summary: You have learned enhanced techniques and alchemical secrets that allow you to expand the range of effects you can impose with your bombs.

name: Greater Magical Edification
summary: You've continued to expand your compendium of tools to compile knowledge.

name: Greater Magical Scholastics
summary: You broaden the scope of your magical understanding, allowing you to find the right path, detect hidden objects, and conceal those objects from unscrupulous rivals.

name: Greater Spell Runes
summary: You gain more powerful spell runes.

name: Greenwatcher
summary: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled.

name: Grief's Fury
summary: A lost love. A broken spear. Rage burning through a hero-god.

name: Growth Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; wood is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental wood, causing your magic to expand and grow beyond its original limitations.

name: Haft Beatdown
summary: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown.

name: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate
summary: Your knowledge of halcyon magic increases.

name: Harden Flesh
summary: You fortify your skin with minerals drawn from earth and stone.

name: Harrying Strike
summary: Your attack prevents a foe from pursuing your allies.

name: Healing Transformation
summary: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries.

name: Helpful Tinkering
summary: You don't just tinker with your own innovation, you fiddle with your allies' weapons as well (for their benefit, of course).

name: Hematocritical
summary: You bathe in the arterial fluids of your enemy, drinking deep of their freed essence to empower your magic and increase your spellcasting efficacy.

name: Heroic Recovery
summary: The restorative power of your healing invigorates the recipient.

name: Hilt Hammer
summary: You know how to turn any weapon into a bone-crushing implement of skeletal destruction.

name: Holy Light
trait: Champion, Cleric, Concentrate, Divine, Evocation, Light, Uncommon
summary: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light.

name: Hook 'Em
summary: The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat.

name: House of Imaginary Walls
summary: You erect an imaginary barrier others believe to be real.

name: Hunting Snag
summary: Learning from nature's predators has taught you how to keep your prey close.

name: I Meant to Do That
prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Trained in Deception
summary: Somehow your stray bullet causes an unintended reaction that creates a problem for your enemy: perhaps a ricochet knocks your foe's weapon away or they stumble over stray debris in an attempt to dodge your bullets.

name: Impose Order (Psychic)
summary: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform.

name: Imposing Destrier
summary: Under your care, your mount has realized its innate potential.

name: Impressive Landing
summary: You slam into the ground, shattering it around you.

name: Improved Command Undead
prerequisite: harmful font; Command Undead; evil alignment
summary: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.

name: Incredible Companion (Ranger)
summary: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

name: Incredible Familiar (Familiar Master)
summary: Your familiar is infused with even more magic than other familiars.

name: Infiltration Assassination
summary: With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them.

name: Instant Armor
summary: A knight is nothing without their armor, and you know how to keep yours ready.

name: Into the Future
summary: You know your spell will be needed not now but in a few moments, so you cast your magic into the future.

name: Invigorating Breath
summary: Your spirit guide exhales its sweet-smelling breath on you, granting you the strength to push through your pain.

name: Journey Of the Sky Chariot
summary: Small wings, flaming wheels, or another signifier of flight sprout from your ikon as it gains the power to lift you from the ground.

name: Just One More Thing
summary: After your attempt to influence someone goes poorly, you add another bit of information or ask a pointed question, possibly salvaging your previous attempt.

name: Klingegeist
summary: Your imprisonment inside a _final blade_ used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder.

name: Knockback
summary: The weight of your swing drives your enemy back.

name: Knockback Strike
summary: You focus your strength into a blow powerful enough to push an enemy away from you.

name: Know it All
summary: Your knowledge of abstruse topics is unparalleled.

name: Lastwall Warden
summary: Use your shield to protect your allies.

name: Lead the Way
summary: You move forward, creating an opening for others to follow.

name: Lesson of the Splintered Aegis
summary: With your attack, you demonstrate to your student a hole in your enemy's defenses.

name: Lessons of Flux
summary: You apply the persistence and permutation taught by faydhaans to your failures.

name: Lethal Edge
summary: When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by _Silent Lenore_.

name: Lightspeed Assault
summary: You zoom from enemy to enemy, striking each in an instant.

name: Litany Against Sloth
summary: You rail against the sin of sloth, turning a foe’s laziness against it.

name: Litany of Self-Interest
summary: You compel a creature to act toward its own ends rather than consider others.

name: Lock On
summary: Aha! You lock on to your enemy's weak point to assist your construct companion in destroying it.

name: Lunging Spellstrike
summary: Your spell unwinds the structure of your staff to make it exceptionally long, or even separate it into shards held together by magical power.

name: Maelstrom Flow
summary: You pour energy into an improvised weapon, speeding its destruction to grant it power.

name: Magical Adaptation
summary: When an obstacle bars your path, you pull a trick from your sleeve to overcome it.

name: Major Lesson
summary: Your patron grants you even greater secrets.

name: Martial Exercise
summary: You've become comfortable in using weapons that you might not have picked up before training with the Swords.

name: Mask of The 12th Step
prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Expert in Crafting
summary: You have reached the 12th Step and been instructed in greater secrets of Razmir’s doctrine.

name: Master Monster Hunter
summary: You have a nearly encyclopedic knowledge of all creatures of the world.

name: Masterful Obfuscation
prerequisite: master in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Scrollmaster Dedication
summary: You've mastered the art of deceiving others about your area of study.

name: Mated Birds in Paired Flight
summary: Your ikons bond like a pair of one-winged birds.

name: Menacing Prowess
prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Intimidation
summary: Scaring off multiple people at once is your specialty.

name: Merciful Elixir
summary: You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker’s body and mind.

name: Merciless Rend
summary: Your eidolon rends its foes.

name: Meteoric Spellstrike
summary: A trail of energy flows from your target back to you.

name: Methodical Debilitations
summary: You strategically craft your debilitations to lessen or negate an enemy’s tactical advantages.

name: Mirror Shield
summary: You reflect the spell back against its caster.

name: Mockingbird's Disarm
summary: The Mockingbird is a master at running into foes and coming away with their weapons.

name: Momentum Strike
summary: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another.

name: Monk's Flurry
summary: You gain the Flurry of Blows action.

name: Nimble Strike
summary: You’re cunning enough to find an opening in an opponent’s attack.

name: Ode to Ouroboros
summary: You learn the ode to ouroboros composition spell (page 371), which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.

name: On Borrowed Time
summary: You accelerate a foe's personal timestream, which causes them to experience time at a faster rate, putting a terrible strain on their mind and body.

name: Ongoing Strategy
summary: You're constantly studying small aspects of everyone's movements, even if you don't have a stratagem in place ahead of time.

name: Open the Blazing Eye
summary: Thanks to your diligence in the study of divine and occult mysteries, you can focus to temporarily attain a perception beyond the ordinary.

name: Opportune Opening
summary: Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe.

name: Overpowering Charge
summary: You trample foes as you charge past.

name: Overwhelming Energy
summary: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies’ resistances.

name: Pact of the Nightblossom
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with Jenway Nightblossom of the Synod of Truth in Dreams, a talented oneiromancer and pactbinder.

name: Pass Through
summary: Filtering your form through the substance of an object, you can pass through walls, doors, and more.

name: Patron's Whisper
summary: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances.

name: Peafowl Strut
summary: You slowly move across the battlefield with dangerous grace.

name: Peerless Warden
summary: Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic.

name: Penetrating Fire
summary: You blast a bullet through one foe and into another.

name: Penetrating Shot
summary: You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey.

name: Perfect Ki Expert
summary: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: _unblinking flame aura_ for Unblinking Flame, _unbreaking wave vapor_ for Unbreaking Waves, _unfolding wind buffet_ for Unfolding Wind, or _untwisting iron roots_ for Untwisting Iron.

name: Petrifying Gaze Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have attempted a saving throw against a creature’s petrifying gaze or a similar ability or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
summary: Either by witnessing or surviving the petrifying stare of a medusa or similar creature, you have learned to petrify those you lock eyes with.

name: Phenom's Verve
summary: You're possessed with an incredibly vivacious spark that separates you not only from ordinary gun users and gunslingers, but even from other phenoms.

name: Plant Shape
summary: You can take the shape of a plant creature.

name: Potent Poisoner
summary: By concentrating your poisons’ toxic components, you make them harder for victims to resist.

name: Practiced Defender
summary: After extensive practice with the Swords, you're comfortable enough with your shield to move at a normal pace with it raised.

name: Practiced Reloads
summary: You've mastered the reloading techniques and methods usually practiced by only the most dedicated firearm professionals.

name: Precious Munitions
summary: You mix flecks of precious materials you've gathered on your journeys into your custom bullets to bring out those properties in your temporary ammunition.

name: Precise Debilitations
summary: You attack with great precision.

name: Preserve the Horde
summary: The act of summoning additional undead minions doesn't make you lose the focus required to maintain the animation of your horde.

name: Prevailing Position
summary: Your flexibility with stances lets you sacrifice their benefits to better protect yourself.

name: Primal Howl
summary: Your companion can let out a howl laced with your primal magic.

name: Pristine Weapon
summary: Your verdant weapon can cut through the resistances of magical creatures.

name: Prophet's Lockbox
summary: You’ve learned secret methods that allow you to store your valuables where no one else can reach them.

name: Propulsive Leap
summary: By expelling flames from your feet or levitating through electrical repulsion, you propel yourself through the air.

name: Protective Bond
summary: The power of your bond can protect you and your eidolon from harm.

name: Protective Strike
summary: You keep harm at bay.

name: Provocator Dedication
summary: For you, fighting is as much about style as skill.

name: Pushing Attack
summary: Your eidolon has an attack that pushes away enemies.

name: Quicken Heartbeat
summary: You’ve replaced your heart with one made of animated quicksilver and living adamantine.

name: Quickened Casting
trait: Bard, Concentrate, Oracle, Sorcerer, Spellshape, Witch, Wizard
summary: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Radiant Armament
summary: Your blessed armament radiates power, further enhancing your chosen weapon.

name: Rain-Scribe Mobility
summary: You surround yourself in a mantle of Rain-Scribe magic and Stride twice; difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed, even if the difficult terrain has been manipulated by magic.

name: Rapid Recharge
summary: You tap into an arcane trick to recover your ability to meld spells and attacks.

name: Reactive Charm
summary: You're so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple enchantment in time to foil an attacker.

name: Rebounding Assault
summary: You hurl your melee weapon at an opponent, then fire a bullet into the weapon's hilt, making it deal additional damage and bounce back to your grasp.

name: Recover Spell
summary: You recover the energy of a recently disrupted spell, allowing you to cast it again as long as you do so immediately before the energy dissipates.

name: Redirecting Draft
summary: You flap your wings to blow arrows off course.

name: Redirecting Shot
summary: Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course.

name: Reflexive Devotion
summary: The power of dragons flows through you at the merest thought.

name: Reflexive Riposte
summary: You can riposte almost without a thought.

name: Renewing Cycle
summary: The first time each round that you Cycle Elemental Stance, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last until the start of your next turn.

name: Replenishment of War
prerequisite: expert in your deity’s favored weapon
summary: Striking out against your enemies draws praise and protection from your deity.

name: Repurposed Parts
summary: You are familiar with the fittings and cogwheels of your snares and can repurpose parts from prepared quick-deploy snares to assemble a new creation on the fly.

name: Resilient Touch
summary: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows.

name: Resounding Blow
summary: You strike your enemy in the head with such force that its ears ring.

name: Reverberating Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; metal is in your elemental philosophy
summary: Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor.

name: Roadkill
summary: In your hands, any vehicle is a weapon.

name: Rockslide Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; earth is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental earth, causing chunks of stone to litter the ground.

name: Rocky Flesh
summary: Your flesh takes on the hardness of stone.

name: Roll the Bones of Fate
summary: You roll a handful of bones to learn (or perhaps influence) the future course of events.

name: Rope Mastery
prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Athletics
summary: Ropes are your tool of choice, and you deploy them in versatile ways.

name: Rubbery Skin
summary: Your skin develops a malleable, rubbery quality.

name: Runic Mind Smithing
summary: You focus your mind on thoughtforms of fundamental magical forces, shaping them into a property rune that you mentally etch onto your mind weapon.

name: Running Kick
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a foot, hoof, or talon unarmed attack
summary: Your companion weaves in and out of combat, swiftly attacking before getting to a better position.

name: Saving Slash
summary: You quickly whirl your blade, trying to deflect enough momentum to avoid the worst of the attack.

name: Scour the Library
summary: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan.

name: Scout's Pounce
summary: You leap from the shadows to strike at your foes.

name: Scroll Adept
summary: During your daily preparations, you can create two temporary scrolls containing arcane spells from your spellbook.

name: Seal of the Golden Dragon
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Golden Dragon's Bounty
summary: Your familiar coils around you, protecting you with its magical resistance.

name: Secrets of Steel
summary: As your prowess with weapons increases, so does the ferocity of magic you channel through those weapons.

name: Seize Advantage
summary: You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself.

name: Sense the Strike
prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Master in Survival
summary: You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge.

name: Shadow Magic
summary: You gain the ability to fuse and play with shadows by using focus spells specific to shadowdancers.

name: Shadow of Death
summary: Strikes you make with your deity’s favored weapon against a creature with the doomed condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

name: Shadow Reservoir
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Shadowcaster Dedication
summary: Your own shadow speaks to you, providing knowledge of spells and a reservoir of magical power.

name: Shadow Sneak Attack
summary: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except you deal 1d6 precision damage regardless of your level.

name: Shall Not Falter, Shall Not Rout
summary: You gain the _shall not falter, shall not rout_ focus spell.

name: Share Weakness
summary: You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you.

name: Shared Avoidance
summary: You can project your premonitions of danger to your allies.

name: Shared Synergy
summary: You can grant the benefit from Dualistic Synergy to an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself, either allowing that ally to Recall Knowledge, granting that ally temporary Hit Points, or both, depending on the spell’s tradition.

name: Shattering Strike (Weapon Improviser)
summary: The improvised weapon shatters, destroying it completely but dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage to the creature you hit with the Improvised Pummel.

name: Shield of Faith
summary: Residual energy from your domain spells bolsters your defenses.

name: Shield of Reckoning
prerequisite: Shield Warden; blessed shield, champion's reaction
summary: When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further.

name: Shield Salvation
summary: You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack.

name: Side by Side (Druid)
summary: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance.

name: Signature Spell Expansion
summary: Your innate connection to magic lets you cast more spells with greater freedom.

name: Signifer's Sight
summary: The magic flowing through your signifer’s mask allows you to see in the dark, and the mask dampens the distraction caused by sudden flashes of bright light.

name: Silencing Strike
summary: A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent.

name: Silent Sting
prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Stealth
summary: You quickly hide your weapon to make it difficult to pin the attack on you.

name: Sin Counterspell
summary: Your deep connection to a specific sin allows you to easily negate spells that sin opposes.

name: Sinking Jaws
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack
summary: Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it.

name: Siphon Life
prerequisite: You've been reduced to 0 Hit Points by an enemy with the void trait.
summary: Experiences with necromantic energy have left a permanent mark on you.

name: Sixth Pillar Dedication
prerequisite: Dexterity 14; Expert in Acrobatics; ability to cast spells
summary: You use your physical discipline to channel your magic.

name: Slayer's Presence
summary: Your very presence strikes fear into the undead.

name: Sleeper Hold
summary: You pinch crucial points of your target's nervous system, impeding its ability to function.

name: Slingshot Maneuver
summary: You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement.

name: Sneak Adept
summary: It’s almost impossible to spot you.

name: Sour Bomb
summary: You can mix ingredients with a powerful sour smell into an alchemical bomb to make its explosion an overpowering stench.

name: Spear of Doom
summary: The conditions for your doom have been met, and you brace yourself for a battle that will see you either live to fight another day or die a legend.

name: Spectral Advance
summary: You gain the _spectral advance_ devotion spell

name: Spell Swallow
summary:
Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the Devour Ambient Magic action.

 **Devour Ambient Magic** <actions string="Reaction" /> (concentrate) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell with you as the only target; **Effect** Your ostilli radiates cyan light as its tentacle-like filters attempt to consume the magical effect.

name: Spellmaster's Ward
summary: You can create a number of powerful shielding runes that bolster your defenses against damaging spells by absorbing the worst of the energy to keep you safe.

name: Spinebreaker
summary: You squeeze your opponent in a vicious bear hug, putting intense pressure on their nerves, joints, or other pain points.

name: Spiritual Flurry
prerequisite: Scion of Domora Dedication; Spiritual Strike
summary: When you use Spiritual Strike, hit targets become off-guard until the end of your current turn.

name: Spraying Mutation
summary: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance.

name: Springboard
summary: You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent.

name: Spy's Countermeasures
summary: You’ve learned how to analyze and fake your responses to the most common magic used against spies.

name: Staggering Blow
summary: You've trained your megafauna companion to stagger its enemies, impeding their ability to fight back.

name: Stalwart Standard
summary: Your banner makes it harder for your foes to push your allies around and encourages your allies to protect the innocent.

name: Standard-Bearer's Sacrifice
summary: Seeing an enemy take aim at your ally, you bravely flourish your banner to redirect their attention to you.

name: Starlit Spells
summary: The stars reveal and punish your enemies.

name: Steal the Sky
summary: You can take away the air that keeps a flying foe aloft.

name: Steal Time
summary: You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time.

name: Stir Allies
summary: You shout a command for your allies to scramble.

name: Stonebane
summary: Your stonestrike attacks deal 1d6 additional damage against constructs, creatures with the earth trait, and earthen objects, such as a stone door.

name: Strident Command
prerequisite: Master in Intimidation; Vigilante Dedication; Voice of Authority; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: The common folk heed your demands, and though your true foes rarely bend to your commands, when they do the hesitation can cost them the battle.

name: Stumbling Finisher
summary: Your excellent display of fighting prowess leaves your opponent stumbling back.

name: Stunt Performer Stance
summary: You clear your mind, regulate your breathing, and prepare your muscles in a stance inspired by Kemen Kayton, a graduate of Zimar’s Monastery of the Seven Forms.

name: Sure-Footed
summary: Even if you're knocked off balance, your armor continues to protect you.

name: Surrounding Flames
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _wall of fire_
summary: When you cast _wall of fire_, you can modify it to create a 10-foot-radius hemisphere of fire.

name: Suspect of Opportunity
summary: Sometimes something intrudes upon your case unexpectedly, such as an ambush sent to bring your investigation to a close.

name: Sustaining Steel
prerequisite: Arcane Cascade, inexorable iron hybrid study
summary: You pull magic into your weapon, using its substance to transform the magic into restorative energy.

name: Sweeping Fan Redirection
prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Sweeping Fan Block
summary: You can redirect ammunition back at the creature that fired it with sweeping gusts of wind.

name: Sweeping Tail
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a tail unarmed attack
summary: Your companion swings its tail powerfully.

name: Switcheroo
summary: You attempt to deftly swap places with an adjacent enemy to avoid the attack.

name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
summary: You learn the symphony of the unfettered heart composition spell (page 371), which enables you to protect an ally against incapacitating conditions.

name: Tactical Debilitations
summary: You learn new debilitations that grant you tactical advantages against your foes.

name: Tactical Reflexes
summary: You are particularly swift at punishing foes who leave you openings.

name: Tag Team
summary: Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike.

name: Tales of the Road
summary: The blessings of Isthralei connect you to the thrum of the stories that underlie all settlements.

name: Tangle of Battle
summary: Your vicious strike pulls your foe closer, giving you the opportunity to grab them.

name: Targeting Finisher
summary: Your attack harms and hinders your foe.

name: Targeting Strike
summary: Your attack creates an opening in your target's defenses for your allies to capitalize on.

name: Tectonic Stomp
summary: You cause minor tremors that topple your enemies.

name: Tempest-Sun Shielding
summary: You transform unrealized spell energy into a protective shield.

name: Terrain Form
summary: You crumble to pieces, becoming composed of the very terrain to which you're bound, with the effects of the _gaseous form_ spell, or you reconstitute into your normal form.

name: Terrifying Howl
summary: You unleash a terrifying howl.

name: Thaumaturge's Investiture
summary: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural.

name: The Dead Walk
summary: You beseech warrior spirits to come forth and aid you.

name: The Truth as I See it
summary: Your knack for spinning a believable reality from threads of story is so practiced that sometimes even you begin to believe  what you're saying.

name: Three Pecks of Dew
summary: At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh.

name: Through Spell
summary: Spells you cast can transform briefly into vital essence, traveling harmlessly through living and undead creatures between you and your target, blocked only by solid objects.

name: Thunderclap Spell
summary: Your lightning splits the air, generating a booming shock wave.

name: Tiller's Aid
summary: You can quickly Aid your crop.

name: Tiller's Drive
summary: Increase your Speed and that of your crop.

name: Topple Foe
summary: You take advantage of the opening created by your ally to tip your foe off their feet.

name: Toppling Tentacles
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _black tentacles_
summary: When you cast _black tentacles_, you can modify it to trip the targets.

name: Torrential Backlash
summary: Calling upon forbidden practices, you release the curse from within yourself, allowing it free rein to destroy everything around you.

name: Touch of Lunacy
summary: In moments of viciousness, your curse can partially infect your prey.

name: Tough Cookie
summary: Though you've taken a lot of punishment, you aren't easily brought down.

name: Trample Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Trample or have identified a creature with Trample in combat
summary: You Stride up to double your speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, trampling each creature whose space you enter.

name: Trampling Charge
summary: You urge your mount to charge into the fray, trampling all enemies who stand in your path.

name: Transcendent Deflection
summary: You charge your weapon with spiritual energy and intercept the attack.

name: Transpose
summary: You switch places with your eidolon.

name: Trial by Skyfire
summary: Your lips murmur as you portend a great disaster, one you hope you survive.

name: Trick Shot
summary: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby.

name: Tumbling Opportunist
summary: You use a burst of stamina to perform a breathtaking feat of Acrobatics as you speed through a foe's space, leaving your foe lying flat on their back.

name: Tunnel
summary: You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet.

name: Turn to Mist
summary: You turn into vapor, gaining the effects of _gaseous form_.

name: Twin Riposte
summary: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon.

name: Twin Shot Knockdown
summary: You fire at an enemy while targeting a part of its anatomy that will disrupt its balance.

name: Twin Weakness
summary: As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh.

name: Unbelievable Escape
summary: Your ability to narrowly evade danger defies all logic.

name: Unbreakable Bond
summary: You and your megafauna companion are bound together; as long as you live, it's much harder for your companion to die.

name: Uncanny Dodge
summary: You gain the deny advantage class feature.

name: Unleash the Blight
summary: You unleash the rot infecting you, spreading the blight to those nearby.

name: Unobstructed Shot
summary: With a quick use of brute force, you remove an obstacle and take a calculated shot as part of the same motion.

name: Unseat
summary: With a mighty blow from atop your companion, you attempt to knock an opponent off their mount.

name: Unsheathing the Sword-Light
summary: Honed through 10,000 battles, your sword’s mere light can shatter ambitions and break armies.

name: Unstable Concoction
summary: You can mix a wondrous yet volatile liquid into an alchemical consumable if it has an initial effect that uses dice.

name: Unusual Composition
summary: You can translate the emotion and power of a composition to other mediums.

name: Uzunjati Recollection
prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
summary: You tell a story spontaneously from nearly forgotten facts, delving into your memory and entertaining your audience in the process.

name: Veil of Bugs
summary: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision.

name: Venipuncture
summary: A shell made up of hundreds of razor-thin needles of blood forms around you before exploding outward.

name: Vermilion Threads
prerequisite: Arcane Cascade; unfurling brocade hybrid study
summary: Your Arcane Cascade sends threads to the four directions, creating a web of strings dyed by your skill and your enemies’ blood.

name: Vicious Debilitations
summary: The debilitations you dish out seriously impair your foes.

name: Vicious Rend
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a claw, fist, pincer, or talon unarmed attack
summary: Your companion sinks its claws and rips.

name: Vigil's Walls Rise Anew!
summary: You can train your allies to Raise a Shield on your order

name: Vindicator's Judgement
summary: You can pronounce judgment on your foes, making them magically susceptible to your attacks.

name: Ward Casting
summary: You carefully ward your spell by drawing from a mantle of magical energy you prepared to protect your casting, increasing your chance of retaining the spell.

name: Warden's Step
summary: You can guide your allies to move quietly through the wilderness.

name: Waters of Creation
trait: Cursebound, Divine, Healing, Oracle, Vitality, Water
summary: Water is the source of life, and you draw upon this primordial force to heal your allies' wounds.

name: Wave Dashes Rocks
summary: You slam an unlucky foe with the tremendous power of a plunging wave.

name: Weapon-Rune Shifter
summary: You learn how to alter the magic of weapon runes by using a crystal as a focusing component.

name: Weighty Impact
summary: Your eidolon knocks enemies down.

name: Whirlwind Stance
prerequisite: Staff Acrobat Dedication; expert proficiency in your staff
summary: You use your staff as a defensive implement as well as an offensive one.

name: Wide Overwatch
summary: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance.

name: Widen the Gap
summary: Once you have penetrated a foe’s defenses, you can home in on the same spot to exploit your opponent’s wound and deal some serious damage.

name: Wind Jump
summary: You gather the wind beneath you, allowing you to soar as you jump.

name: Winding Flow
summary: Any journey consists of more than simply reaching your destination.

name: Wing Rider
summary: Your bond with your dragon has been honed so fine that it can carry you aloft with its full capability.

name: Winter's Embrace
summary: Your eyes are accustomed to the harsh glare of the sun on snow and ice.

name: Witch's Communion
summary: You can keep watch over multiple charges.

name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
summary: You gain the wronged monk's wrath ki spell.

name: A Home in Every Port
summary: You have a reputation in towns and villages you've visited, and residents are always willing to open their doors to you.

name: Axuma's Awakening
prerequisite: Exposure to the Well of Axuma
summary: Exposure of the well of Axuma has given you some arcane magic.

name: Axuma's Vigor
prerequisite: Exposure to the Well of Axuma
summary: Your vigor makes it easier for others to heal you.

name: Caravan Leader
summary: You know how to get the most effort out of your allies on the road.

name: Fame and Fortune
summary: Gain RP when you critically succeed at Kingdom skills

name: Incredible Investiture
summary: Invest up to 12 magic items

name: Incredible Scout
summary: When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight.

name: Sanguine Tenacity
summary: Your blood carries permanent regenerative properties.

name: Acknowledge Fan
trait: Archetype, Enchantment, Incapacitation, Mental, Uncommon, Visual
summary: Your reputation as a Firebrand precedes you, and you need only make a simple gesture or give a look of recognition to amaze those around you.

name: Additional Shadow Magic
summary: Choose an additional shadowdancer focus spell you haven't already selected from Shadow Magic.

name: Adept Storyteller
prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
summary: Your ability to tell stories rivals those of the finest bards.

name: Advanced Firearm Familiarity
prerequisite: Gunslinger Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
summary: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency.

name: Advanced Order Training
prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; Hellknight Dedication or Hellknight Signifer Dedication
summary: You gain the greater order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

name: Advanced Seeker of Truths
prerequisite: Eldritch Researcher Dedication; Seeker of Truths
summary: You have unlocked deeper secrets to uncovering and hoarding lore.

name: Aegis of Arnisant
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Shield Block; Master in Religion
summary: Inspired by the tale of Arnisant, you transform your shield into a magic ward.

name: Affliction Mercy
summary: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction.

name: Alchemical Power
summary: You become an expert in the alchemist class DC.

name: Amp Focus
summary: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind.

name: Amplifying Touch
summary: Your healing energies empower attacks.

name: Apparition Cloud
summary: With a mere thought, you discorporate your familiar into a thousand shards of spiritual magic, protecting both it and yourself from physical harm while making it difficult for enemies to move near you.

name: Architect of Flame
trait: Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal
summary: Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design.

name: Armor Break
summary: You flex your muscles to crack your damaged armor, blasting jagged shards into nearby enemies.

name: Armored Counterattack
summary: With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies.

name: Assassinate
summary: You strike with one swift movement, trying to instantly slay your mark.

name: Aura of Confidence
summary: Your will and your faith in your nation is unassailable, and the feeling is contagious.

name: Aura of Faith
summary: You radiate an aura of belief that imbues your attacks and those of nearby allies with divine power.

name: Banshee Cry Display
summary: You’ve learned how to unleash a sudden and disruptive noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can cause a spellcaster to fumble the phrasing of their magic

name: Battlefield Arcana
summary: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle.

name: Beastmaster's Call
summary: You quickly call in a primal projection of a non-active companion to provide the companion’s support benefit.

name: Billowing Wings
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with wings
summary: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them.

name: Blade of Justice
summary: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed harming an ally or innocent.

name: Blade of Law
summary: You call upon the power of law and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed breaking or disrespecting the law or otherwise acting disorderly.

name: Blade of the Crimson Oath
summary: You call upon the Crimson Oath to smite undead and then make a weapon or unarmed Strike against an undead foe.

name: Bleak Humorist
summary: You’ve watched dozens of morbid comedies depicting Beldam I, Taldor’s prankster emperor whose wife accidentally killed him when she struck him with a marble bust after he jumped out from behind curtains to frighten her.

name: Blessed Counterstrike
prerequisite: champion’s reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy’s damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)
summary: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction.

name: Blessed Denial
summary: You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally.

name: Blood Component Substitution
summary: You can bypass the need for incantations and gestures by drawing energy directly from your blood, causing you to visibly glow the color of your blood and crackle with magical energy.

name: Blood in the Air
summary: Once you've locked on to a target, little can obscure your aim.

name: Blood Sovereignty
summary: You wield blood magic masterfully.

name: Bloodline Focus
summary: By listening to the beating of your heart, your focus recovers faster.

name: Bloody Debilitation
summary: Your attacks slice arteries and veins.

name: Boost Modulation
summary: You aren't satisfied with keeping to just one kind of boost from your constant tinkering, so you've learned to modulate between several possibilities at once.

name: Brutal Finish
summary: Your final blow can make an impact even if it rebounds off a foe’s defenses.

name: Buzzing Death Cicadas
summary: Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise.

name: Call The Hunt
summary: You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey.

name: Cartwheel Dodge
summary: You can dodge away from damaging effects.

name: Catch and Kill
summary: When you’ve decided to quash a story, no one can escape from you with any incriminating information.

name: Cautious Word
summary: You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge.

name: Celestial Cacophony
trait: Fire, Inventor, Manipulate, Sonic, Uncommon, Visual
summary: Your weapon contains a detonation chamber that launches fireworks, sparklers, and black powder pellets that sizzle, twist, and scatter on the ground in a cacophonous manner liable to annoy the entire Celestial Court.

name: Cellular Reconstruction
summary: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die.

name: Chain Reaction
summary: You fire your gun once, creating a devastating and unpredictable chain of events; perhaps your bullet strikes exactly the right spot on a water tower, causing it to flood and incite a stampede of horses which knock over a lantern that sets a city on fire.

name: Champion's Sacrifice
summary: You can suffer so that others might live.

name: Charged Creation
summary: Your magic is drawn to your persistent creations.

name: Cheat Death
summary: Somehow you always escape the reaper by a hair's breadth.

name: Choking Smoke
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify it to create a cloud of smoking smoke.

name: Chorus Companion
summary: Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience.

name: Claw and Talon Flow
summary: You fluidly shift between your two stances.

name: Clever Counterspell
summary: You creatively apply your prepared spells to Counterspell a much wider variety of your opponents’ magic.

name: Coffin Bound
summary: You bind your spirit to a coffin filled with soil of your homeland, making it a place of recovery.

name: Collapse Wall
summary: You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature.

name: Combat Premonition
summary: By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies.

name: Communal Sustain
summary: Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect.

name: Competitive Eater
summary: Gorging on flesh after your stomach is full fortifies you, making you hardy enough to withstand more punishment.

name: Compliant Gold
summary: You can command your weapon to shrink or grow, for convenience or power.

name: Conflux Focus
summary: You imagine how you'll weave magic and combat into future battles, improving your focus.

name: Consult the Spirits (Rivethun Emissary)
summary: You spend 1 hour communing with powerful spirits of the world to gain insight, information, or advice.

name: Contingency Gadgets
summary: You are too brilliant to be caught off guard, and you always have just the right gadget for the situation.

name: Coordinated Charge
summary: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow.

name: Coordinated Distraction
summary: You distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them.

name: Coordinated Tactics
summary: You and your follower fight in tandem.

name: Corpse Stench
summary: Your body exudes an overwhelming scent of decay in a 10-foot emanation, so putrid that it nauseates creates within that range.

name: Coven Spell
summary: You rhyme with your ally’s incantations or echo their movements, linking your magic to empower their spell in one of two ways.

name: Cracked Mountain
summary: You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe.

name: Crimson Breath
summary: You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm.

name: Critical Debilitation
summary: Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks.

name: Cut the Bonds
prerequisite: Bellflower Dedication; expert in a melee weapon
summary: You can counteract a magical effect that impedes movement.

name: Danse Macabre
summary: Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward.

name: Daredevil's Gambit
summary: If you critically succeed at your Daring Act, you can enter the target’s space and remain there until the beginning of your next turn or until the target moves, whichever comes first.

name: Dashing Strike
summary: Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another.

name: Deadeye
summary: You relax your eyes, taking in the presence of hidden things, granting you the ability to locate invisible creatures.

name: Deadly Poison Weapon
summary: Your poisons are devastatingly potent.

name: Death Dive
summary: You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe.

name: Deep Freeze
summary: You vent a jet of supercooled fluid from your innovation, damaging a foe and slowing it down.

name: Defensive Dismissal
summary: You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow.

name: Defensive Recovery
summary: Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing.

name: Desiccating Inhalation
summary: You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds.

name: Desperate Wish
summary: You call out a desperate wish to the stars to save a friend.

name: Determined Lore Seeker
summary: You've mastered useful spells that let you find hidden truths others might miss.

name: Devastating Shield Wallop
summary: The impact of your shield sends foes tumbling to the ground.

name: Devoted Focus
summary: Your devotion is strong enough to increase your focus to incredible heights.

name: Diamond Soul
summary: You have fortified your body and mind against eldritch effects.

name: Directed Poison
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _cloudkill_
summary: When you cast _cloudkill_, you can modify it to be under your control.

name: Disrupt Qi
summary: You carefully target a creature's pressure points to block its inner life force.

name: Distracting Shot
summary: The sheer power of your attacks, or the overwhelming number of them, leaves an enemy flustered.

name: Diverse Weapon Expert
prerequisite: Fighter Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
summary: Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, and your proficiency rank for advanced weapons increases to trained.

name: Divine Wall
summary: You use your shield to harry your enemies, preventing them from stepping away from or around you.

name: Dodging Roll
summary: You dodge a blow at the last possible moment.

name: Domain Fluency
summary: You command a deep understanding of the domains related to your mystery.
